book_name: 高中英语常考短语与句型

words.tr: phrase. 沉溺于；放纵自己于（某种情感或行为）
words.ex: He abandon himself to sadness after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 他在失去之后沉溺于悲伤。
words.en: To give oneself over completely to a feeling, emotion, or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要；首先
words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: v. 符合；“accord”的现在分词；
words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 指责某人做某事；因某事而控告或指责某人
words.ex: He was accused of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷了钱。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.tr: phrase. 充当；担任；担当
words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 适应
words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 添加；加入
words.ex: Please add in the sugar before you mix the dough.
words.ex_cn: 请在和面之前把糖加进去。
words.en: Include something as an additional part or ingredient.

words.tr: phrase. 适应； 调节
words.ex: He needs to adjust to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应新学校。
words.en: If you adjust to a new situation or get used to it, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you can deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 承认做了某事
words.ex: He admitted stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他承认偷了钱。
words.en: To acknowledge something as true, often reluctantly, especially a wrongdoing.

words.tr: phrase. 毕竟；终究
words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.tr: phrase. 对...达成协议；对...取得一致意见
words.ex: They agree on the plan for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们对旅行的计划达成一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual understanding or consensus about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在 ... 前面
words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.tr: phrase. 完全独自一人；孤零零地
words.ex: He sat all alone in the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人坐在黑暗的房间里。
words.en: Completely by oneself; without any companions.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. 突然
words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 一生中；终生；一辈子
words.ex: He has worked as a teacher all one's life.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都当老师。
words.en: For the entire duration of one's existence.

words.tr: phrase. 到处；四处；完了
words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.tr: phrase. 好吧；好的
words.ex: All right, let's go now.
words.ex_cn: 好吧，我们现在走吧。
words.en: If you say that something is all right, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: adj. 全能的；多方面的；多才多艺的
words.ex: He is an all-round athlete who plays soccer, basketball, and tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名全能运动员，踢足球、打篮球和打网球。
words.en: Having a wide range of abilities or uses; versatile.

words.tr: phrase. 周围；四处
words.ex: The children are playing all around the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园周围玩耍。
words.en: In all directions or in every part of a place.

words.tr: phrase. 一切顺利；祝你好运
words.ex: All the best in your new job!
words.ex_cn: 祝你在新工作中一切顺利！
words.en: a phrase used to wish someone success or good luck in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；仍然；还是
words.ex: He didn't study, but all the same, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，但尽管如此，他还是通过了考试。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.tr: phrase. 一路上；一直；完全
words.ex: He walked all the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他一路走到学校。
words.en: From the beginning to the end; completely.

words.tr: phrase. 整个期间；自始至终
words.ex: He slept all through the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他整个电影时间都在睡觉。
words.en: During the entire period of something; throughout.

words.tr: adv. 总共；完全；
words.ex: There are altogether five apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上面总共有五个苹果。
words.en: Altogether is used to emphasize that something is completely the case or to indicate the total number or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.tr: phrase. 等等
words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so on.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could also be mentioned.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr: phrase. 决不；一点也不
words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；除...之外
words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: v. 道歉
words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: phrase. 请求；申请
words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成；满意
words.ex: My parents approve of my new job.
words.ex_cn: 我父母赞成我的新工作。
words.en: To have a favorable opinion of someone or something; to agree with or support a decision, action, or suggestion.

words.tr: phrase. 起于；由…引起
words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: 短语. 胳膊挽着胳膊；表示亲密或团结地走在一起
words.ex: They walked arm in arm down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他们臂挽着臂走在街上。
words.en: Walking or standing with your arm linked with someone else's arm, usually as a sign of friendship or affection.

words.tr: 短语. 在拐角附近；即将到来；就在眼前
words.ex: The store is around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 商店就在拐角处。
words.en: If you say that something is around the corner, you mean that it is very near or will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；达成；达到
words.ex: We arrive at the station at 9 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们九点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a destination or to come to a decision or conclusion after consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 因此；结果
words.ex: He didn't study, as a consequence, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，结果考试没及格。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上
words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 结果
words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.tr: phrase. 如下
words.ex: The steps are as follows.
words.ex_cn: 步骤如下。
words.en: used to introduce a list of items or points

words.tr: phrase. 关于；至于
words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: phrase. 只要
words.ex: You can go out so long as you finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 只要你做完作业，就可以出去。
words.en: provided that; on condition that

words.tr: phrase. 一…就…；尽快
words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.tr: phrase. 照常
words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 也；同样；又；还
words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr: phrase. 也；又
words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 要；要求；请求
words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.tr: 短语. 在远处；不亲近地；保持距离地
words.ex: The two dogs barked at a distance from each other.
words.ex_cn: 两只狗隔着一段距离互相吠叫。
words.en: If something is at a distance, it is far away from you.

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 以低价；便宜地
words.ex: He bought the bike at a low price.
words.ex_cn: 他以低价买了这辆自行车。
words.en: For a small amount of money.

words.tr: phrase. 每次；一次；在某时
words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.tr: phrase. 根本；完全
words.ex: I don't like coffee at all.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used to emphasize a negative statement, meaning 'in any way' or 'to any extent'.

words.tr: phrase. 不惜任何代价；无论如何
words.ex: He will finish the project at all costs.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会不惜一切代价完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something must be done at all costs, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or causes a lot of problems.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；至少
words.ex: I don't like the movie, but at any rate, it was short.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，但无论如何，它很短。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true or relevant in any case.

words.tr: 短语. 轻松的；不拘束的；稍息（军事口令）
words.ex: He feels at ease when he is with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 当他和朋友在一起时，他感到轻松自在。
words.en: If you are at ease, you are feeling confident and relaxed, and are able to talk to people without feeling nervous or awkward.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起先
words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 乍看之下；一见就
words.ex: At first sight, the puzzle looks easy.
words.ex_cn: 乍一看，这个拼图很简单。
words.en: If you say that something seems to have a particular quality at first sight, you mean that it seems to have that quality when you first see it or first think about it, but that it may not really have that quality.

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；在附近；即将到来
words.ex: The solution is at hand.
words.ex_cn: 解决办法就在眼前。
words.en: If something is at hand, it is nearby or about to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；终于
words.ex: He finished his homework at last.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: After a long time or delay; finally.

words.tr: phrase. 至少；不少于；起码
words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；详尽地
words.ex: He talked at length about his trip finally.
words.ex_cn: 他最后详细谈到了他的旅行。
words.en: If someone does something at length, they do it for a long time or in great detail.

words.tr: phrase. 至多；最多
words.ex: You can have at most three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: You use at most or at the most to say that a number or amount is the maximum that is possible and that the actual number or amount may be smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 最多；至多
words.ex: He has at the most three apples.
words.ex_cn: 他最多有三个苹果。
words.en: Indicating a maximum limit; not more than.

words.tr: phrase. 马上
words.ex: He stopped talking at once.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻停止了说话。
words.en: Immediately; without delay; at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 处在最佳状态；在全盛时期
words.ex: She is at her best when she sings on stage.
words.ex_cn: 当她站在舞台上唱歌时，她是最出色的。
words.en: If you are at your best, you are performing or behaving as well as you are able to.

words.tr: phrase. 现在；目前
words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.tr: phrase. 胡乱地； 随便地
words.ex: He picked a number at random.
words.ex_cn: 他随机选了一个数字。
words.en: If you choose people or things at random, you do not use any particular method, so they all have an equal chance of being chosen.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人方便的时候；根据某人的便利
words.ex: You can call me at your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 你可以方便的时候给我打电话。
words.en: At a time or place that suits someone.

words.tr: phrase. 以某人为代价；由某人付费；拿某人开玩笑
words.ex: He laughed at his friend's expense.
words.ex_cn: 他以朋友为代价取笑。
words.en: If something is done at someone's expense, they are the ones who suffer or pay for it, often in a way that is unfair or that benefits someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 听候某人吩咐；乐意帮助某人
words.ex: I am at your service if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，我随时为你效劳。
words.en: Ready to help or be used by someone.

words.tr: 短语. 在进餐时；在吃饭
words.ex: He is eating at table with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他正和家人在餐桌旁吃饭。
words.en: At table means sitting at a table, especially for a meal.

words.tr: 短语. 在……岁时
words.ex: He started school at the age of six.
words.ex_cn: 他六岁时开始上学。
words.en: Used to indicate the specific age at which something happens or someone does something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的开始
words.ex: At the beginning of the class, the teacher gave us homework.
words.ex_cn: 在课程开始时，老师给我们布置了作业。
words.en: At the start of something; at the point when something starts.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的底部；在……的尽头
words.ex: The cat is at the bottom of the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫在楼梯底部。
words.en: At the lowest part or point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...结尾；在....末端
words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.tr: phrase. 当时；此刻；现在
words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: phrase. 处于战争状态的；交战的
words.ex: The two countries are at war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家处于战争状态。
words.en: Engaged in a war or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 在工作；在运转
words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.tr: v. 附加；系上；
words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.tr: phrase. 试图做某事；尝试做某事
words.ex: He attempts to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图解决这道数学题。
words.en: Make an effort to achieve or complete a task.

words.tr: phrase. 专心；注意；照顾
words.ex: Please attend to your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 现在请专心做你的作业。
words.en: To deal with or take care of something; to give attention to someone or something.

words.tr: n. 态度；看法；姿态；
words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的态度；对…的看法
words.ex: Her attitude toward the new policy was skeptical.
words.ex_cn: 她对新政策持怀疑态度。
words.en: A manner of thinking, feeling, or behaving that reflects a state of mind or disposition towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于……；认为……是由于……
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: To explain or credit something (e.g., a quality, event, or discovery) as being caused by a specific person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 避免做某事
words.ex: He avoids eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃太多糖。
words.en: To refrain from performing a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；醒悟到；开始认识到（某事物）
words.ex: He is awake to the dangers of smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到了吸烟的危害。
words.en: To become aware of or realize something.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地；一来一往
words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人就某事讨价还价
words.ex: She tried to bargain with the shopkeeper for a lower price.
words.ex_cn: 她试图与店主讨价还价，以获得更低的价格。
words.en: To negotiate with someone in order to reach an agreement on the price or terms of something.

words.tr: phrase. 将……建立在……基础上；以……为依据
words.ex: He bases his opinion on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他根据事实形成自己的观点。
words.en: To use something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 能够做某事；有能力完成某事
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the necessary skill, knowledge, time, money, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，用于描述马上要发生的动作，后接动词原形
words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开家。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；专心于
words.ex: He is absorbed in reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正专心致志地读书。
words.en: To be so interested in something that you do not notice anything else.

words.tr: phrase. 富于；有丰富的…
words.ex: This forest is abundant in birds and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和树很多。
words.en: To exist in large quantities or be plentiful within a specific place or context.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于···
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；对…上瘾
words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 被允许进入；被接纳入
words.ex: She was admitted into the prestigious university after passing the entrance exam.
words.ex_cn: 在通过入学考试后，她被这所著名大学录取了。
words.en: To be allowed to enter a place or to join an organization or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 被允许进入；被接纳（如入学、入院等）
words.ex: He was admitted to the university last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被大学录取了。
words.en: To be allowed to enter or join a particular place, organization, or course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 生…的气；对…感到气愤
words.ex: My mom is angry with me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈因为我回家晚而生我的气。
words.en: To feel or show anger towards someone because of something they have done.

words.tr: phrase. 担心……的；对……感到焦虑的
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: To feel worried or nervous about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到羞愧；因……而内疚
words.ex: He is ashamed of his bad grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己糟糕的成绩感到羞愧。
words.en: To feel shame or guilt about something you have done or about a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 被赋予；有幸拥有（某种天赋、品质或好处）
words.ex: She is blessed with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: v. 她有幸拥有音乐天赋。
words.en: To be fortunate enough to have something, especially a quality or ability.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到厌烦；对……失去兴趣
words.ex: He is bored with doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To feel weary and impatient because one is unoccupied or lacks interest in one's current activity.

words.tr: phrase. 一定会做某事；注定要做某事
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力学习，他一定会通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr: phrase. 忙于某事
words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: To be actively engaged in a task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 能够
words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 接近；靠近；紧挨着
words.ex_cn: 学校离公园很近。
words.en: To be near in space, time, or relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 关心；挂念
words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 满足于； 对 ... 感到满足
words.ex: He is content with his small house.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的小房子感到满足。
words.en: To be satisfied with what one has or is, without desiring more or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 着迷的；狂热的；热衷于
words.ex: He is crazy about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他酷爱打篮球。
words.en: To be extremely enthusiastic or passionate about something.

words.tr: adj. 好奇的
words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 和 ... 不同
words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 相等；胜任
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 面临
words.ex: He is faced with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: If you are faced with a problem or a difficult situation, you have to deal with it.

words.tr: phrase. 被某人熟悉
words.ex: This song is familiar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌对他来说很熟悉。
words.en: If something is familiar to you, you recognize it or know it well.

words.tr: phrase. 以……而闻名；作为……出名
words.ex: He is famous as a singer.
words.ex_cn: 他以歌手的身份而出名。
words.en: To be well known for a particular quality or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 适合……的；具备……资格的
words.ex_cn: 他不适合这份工作。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or role.

words.tr: phrase. 喜爱；喜欢
words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕得要死；吓得魂飞魄散
words.ex: He was frightened to death by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那声巨响吓死了。
words.en: Be extremely frightened or scared.

words.tr: phrase. 充满
words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长
words.ex: He is good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感兴趣
words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 被称作；以…闻名
words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.tr: phrase. 很可能；有希望
words.ex: He is likely to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is likely to happen or is likely to be true, you mean that it will probably happen or that it is probably true.

words.tr: phrase. 沉浸于；全神贯注于；迷失在
words.ex: He is lost in his thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 他沉浸在自己的思绪中。
words.en: To be so absorbed in something that one is unaware of one's surroundings.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……挑剔；对……讲究
words.ex: He is particular about his coffee always being hot.
words.ex_cn: 他对咖啡总是要热的很讲究。
words.en: To be very careful or concerned about something, especially in a way that is considered excessive or unnecessary.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到高兴；对……满意
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到高兴。
words.en: To feel happy or satisfied about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到高兴；对……感到满意
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到高兴。
words.en: To feel happy or satisfied about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...喜欢；对…满意
words.ex: He is pleased with his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到满意。
words.en: To feel satisfaction or happiness about something.

words.tr: phrase. 受...欢迎
words.ex: This song is popular with teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is popular with a particular group of people, they are liked or admired by those people.

words.tr: phrase. 自豪
words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为...做准备
words.ex: He is ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好考试了。
words.en: To be prepared or in a state of readiness for something that is expected to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关
words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关
words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 对...负责
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 对…敏感
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: To be easily affected or influenced by something, especially in a way that is not desired.

words.tr: phrase. 是……的缩写；是……的简称
words.ex: The name 'Bob' is short for Robert.
words.ex_cn: ‘Bob’是‘Robert’的缩写。
words.en: If something is short for a particular word or name, it is a shorter way of saying or writing it.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: 短语. 在...方面严格
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业要求严格。
words.en: To adhere firmly to rules or standards in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 应该；被期望
words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 对……有把握；确信……
words.ex: I am not sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我不确定这个答案。
words.en: To be certain or confident about something.

words.tr: phrase. 确信
words.ex: He is sure of his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他确信自己的答案。
words.en: If you are sure of something, you are confident that it is true or correct.

words.tr: phrase. 对…厌烦
words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: 短语. 对...适用；对...来说是真实的
words.ex: It is true of cats that they like to sleep in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 猫喜欢晒太阳，这一点是真实的。
words.en: If something is true of a person or thing, it applies to them or is valid in their case.

words.tr: phrase. 是…所独有的；独特于
words.ex: This pattern is unique to this region.
words.ex_cn: 这种图案只存在于这个地区。
words.en: Be distinctive or characteristic of a particular person, place, or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮朋友做作业。
words.en: If you are willing to do something, you are ready and eager to do it and have no objection to doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 因为
words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 会怎样；发生什么情况（通常用于疑问句，表示对某人或某物未来的关切）
words.ex: I wonder what will become of him after he leaves school.
words.ex_cn: 我不禁想知道他离开学校后会怎么样。
words.en: If you wonder what has become of someone or something, you wonder where they are and what has happened to them.

words.tr: phrase. 不久以后
words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为起点；首先
words.ex: The lesson begins with a simple question.
words.ex_cn: 这节课以一个简单的问题开始。
words.en: To start with something, especially as a first step or part of a process.

words.tr: phrase. 相信；信任
words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 信不信由你
words.ex: Believe it or not, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 信不信由你，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that may seem surprising or unbelievable.

words.tr: phrase. 属于
words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 受益于
words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 无法控制的；超出控制范围的
words.ex: The fire grew beyond control.
words.ex_cn: 火势变得无法控制。
words.en: If something is beyond control, it is impossible to manage or regulate.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事责备某人
words.ex: He blames his brother for breaking the vase.
words.ex_cn: 他责怪他弟弟打碎了花瓶。
words.en: To hold someone responsible for a fault or wrong.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 彻底击败；使印象深刻；吹走
words.ex: The champion blew away all his opponents in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 冠军在决赛中彻底击败了所有对手。
words.en: To remove something by blowing, or to cause someone to be very surprised.

words.tr: phrase. 突然离开； 突然挣脱；决裂； 退出
words.ex: He broke away from the group and ran home.
words.ex_cn: 他突然离开团队，跑回家了。
words.en: To leave or escape from a person, group, or situation that controls or restricts you.

words.tr: phrase. 脱离；摆脱
words.ex: He tried to break away from his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他试图摆脱旧习惯。
words.en: To leave or escape from a group, place, or situation, especially in order to start something new or different.

words.tr: phrase. 带来；引起
words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使建筑物等）烧毁；烧成平地
words.ex: The old house burned down in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子在火灾中被烧毁了。
words.en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；突然发作
words.ex: The thieves burst into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: If you burst into a particular kind of activity, you suddenly start doing it.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 偶然地；意外地
words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 乘飞机；通过航空
words.ex: He sent the package by air.
words.ex_cn: 他通过空运寄出了包裹。
words.en: Using aircraft as a means of transport.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 碰巧；偶然；意外地
words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: 短语，按名字；名叫……的
words.ex: The teacher called the students by name.
words.ex_cn: 老师按名字叫学生。
words.en: By name means to refer to someone or something using their name.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 引起对…的注意；使关注
words.ex: He raised his hand to call attention to the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来指出这个错误。
words.en: To make someone notice something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 访问（某地）；停靠（某地）
words.ex: He will call at the post office after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会去邮局。
words.en: To visit a place, especially briefly, or to stop at a place during a journey.

words.tr: phrase. 平静下来；镇定下来
words.ex: Please calm down and talk slowly.
words.ex_cn: 请冷静下来，慢慢说。
words.en: To become or make someone become quiet and relaxed after being angry, excited, or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 不得不，只能
words.ex: I can't but laugh when I see that funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那只搞笑的猫时，我只能笑。
words.en: used to say that you have to do something because there is no other choice

words.tr: 情不自禁地；不由得（后面接动词原形，表示无法抑制做某事）
words.ex: I can't help but smile when I see my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到我的狗时，我忍不住微笑。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 情不自禁做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I can't help laughing when I see that movie.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那部电影时，我忍不住笑。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.tr: 短语，迫不及待地想要做某事
words.ex: I can't wait to see my friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我迫不及待想明天见我的朋友。
words.en: to be very excited about something and eager for it to happen

words.tr: phrase. 关心；担心
words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎他的朋友们。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr: phrase. 运走；使失去自制力
words.ex: Don't carry away the books from this table.
words.ex_cn: 不要把桌上的书拿走。
words.en: To take or move someone or something from one place to another, often with some force or enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. v. 到处寻找；苦苦思索以找到
words.ex: He cast about for a solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他四处寻找解决问题的办法。
words.en: To search or look for something in a determined way.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抛弃；丢弃；抛弃某人或某物；不再考虑
words.ex: He cast aside his old shoes and bought new ones.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了旧鞋，买了新鞋。
words.en: To get rid of someone or something because you no longer want or need them.

words.tr: phrase. 瞥见
words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 着火
words.ex: The paper caught fire quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纸很快着火了。
words.en: To begin to burn; to ignite.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；握住；控制住
words.ex: He tries to catch hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To grasp or seize something, especially something that is moving or difficult to grasp.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrase. 追上；赶上
words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.tr: phrase. 供应伙食；迎合
words.ex: The café caters for breakfast and lunch.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆供应早餐和午餐。
words.en: To cater for something means to provide all the things that are needed or wanted for a particular purpose or event.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为中心；重点在于…
words.ex: The lesson centers on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这节课的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为中心；围绕；集中于
words.ex: The discussion centers upon the main problem.
words.ex_cn: 讨论集中在主要问题上。
words.en: To focus or concentrate on something as the main point of interest or activity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 用……替换……；将……换成……
words.ex: I want to change my shirt for a T-shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我想把我的衬衫换成一件T恤。
words.en: To exchange something for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 变成；转换成
words.ex: She will change into her pajamas after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后会换上睡衣。
words.en: To become something different or to make something become different.

words.tr: phrase. 改变主意
words.ex: He changed his mind and decided to go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了主意，决定去参加派对。
words.en: If you change your mind, you make a different decision or have a different opinion from the one you had before.

words.tr: phrase. 控告；指控
words.ex: The police charged him with stealing.
words.ex_cn: 警察指控他偷窃。
words.en: To formally accuse someone of committing a crime.

words.tr: phrase. 登记；报到
words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.tr: phrase. 为…鼓劲加油
words.ex: They go to the game to cheer on their team.
words.ex_cn: 他们去比赛为他们的队伍加油。
words.en: To encourage someone or a team to do their best, especially by shouting and showing support.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；详细讨论
words.ex: He chewed over the problem for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他思考了这个问题好几个小时。
words.en: To think about something carefully for a long time, especially before making a decision.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （与他人一起）凑钱，捐款；（在讨论中）插话，发表意见
words.ex: Everyone can chip in to buy a gift for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都可以出点钱给老师买礼物。
words.en: If someone chips in, they contribute money or help to something.

words.tr: phrase. 切断；中止；扼杀（供应、流动或进程等）
words.ex: The police tried to choke off the supply of illegal drugs.
words.ex_cn: 警方试图切断非法毒品的供应。
words.en: To stop or prevent something from continuing or developing.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 清理；清除；收拾
words.ex: He will clear away the toys from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他会把地上的玩具清理掉。
words.en: To remove items or obstacles from a place so that it is tidy or unobstructed.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.tr: phrase. 点击（鼠标）以选择或激活某项功能
words.ex: Click on the blue button to start.
words.ex_cn: 点击蓝色按钮开始。
words.en: Select or activate something on a computer screen using a mouse or touch.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.tr: phrase. v. 恢复镇定；使自己冷静下来；整理思绪
words.ex: After the shock, he took a deep breath to collect himself.
words.ex_cn: 震惊过后，他深吸一口气让自己镇定下来。
words.en: To regain control of one's emotions or thoughts after being upset or confused.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；造成
words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 形成；产生
words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；出来；出版
words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. v. 接受（现实、情况等）；与……达成协议；妥协
words.ex: He finally came to terms with his failure.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了失败。
words.en: To accept something that one cannot change, especially a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成真
words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；提出；想出
words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 赔偿
words.ex: The company will compensate for the damaged items.
words.ex_cn: 公司将赔偿损坏的物品。
words.en: To compensate for something means to do something to reduce or balance the negative effect of something else.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨
words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨
words.ex: He complain of headache every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都抱怨头痛。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 集中精力于；专注于
words.ex: You need to concentrate upon your studies to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 你需要专心于学习才能成功。
words.en: To focus all one's attention or effort on a particular object or activity.

words.tr: v. 祝贺；恭喜
words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 向……祝贺……；就……向某人表示祝贺
words.ex: We congratulate you upon your success.
words.ex_cn: 我们祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: To express to someone your pleasure at their success or good fortune, especially by saying 'congratulations'.

words.tr: phrase. 连接；联络
words.ex: The bridge connects with the other side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接到河的另一边。
words.en: To establish a relationship or communication with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 将……视为……；认为……是……
words.ex: People often consider dogs as good friends.
words.ex_cn: 人们通常把狗看作好朋友。
words.en: To think of someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 存在于…中；在内
words.ex: Happiness consists in simple moments.
words.ex_cn: 幸福在于简单的时刻。
words.en: If you say that something consists in a particular thing, you mean that the thing mentioned is the main or essential feature of it.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相反
words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: v. 说服；使确信；
words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: phrase. 冷却下来；平静下来；使冷静
words.ex: The car needs time to cool down after driving.
words.ex_cn: 汽车行驶后需要时间冷却下来。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something become less hot; to become calm after being angry.

words.tr: phrase. v. 冷静下来；使冷却；（使）平息怒气
words.ex: He needs to cool off after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后需要冷静一下。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something less hot; to become calmer or less excited.

words.tr: phrase. 与···相应；符合
words.ex: The number 5 corresponds to the letter E.
words.ex_cn: 数字5对应字母E。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is a cause or a result of the other.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；指望
words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 依靠；指望；信赖
words.ex: You can count upon me to help you.
words.ex_cn: 你可以指望我帮你。
words.en: To rely on someone or something to do what you expect or need.

words.tr: phrase. 划掉；删除（文字或项目）
words.ex: He crosses out the wrong answer and writes the correct one.
words.ex_cn: 他划掉错误的答案，写上正确的答案。
words.en: To draw a line through something written to indicate that it is incorrect or should be disregarded.

words.tr: phrase. 涌入；蜂拥而至；（想法或记忆）纷至沓来
words.ex: People crowded in the square when the concert started.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会开始时，人们涌向广场。
words.en: If people crowd in, they come together in large numbers, often in a way that is uncomfortable or difficult to manage.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 大声喊叫；呼喊；迫切需要
words.ex: The child cried out when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 那个孩子从自行车上摔下来时大声哭喊。
words.en: To shout or scream loudly, often because of pain, fear, or anger.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路通过；越（界）；影响，涉及（不同群体）；违背
words.ex: The path cuts across the field.
words.ex_cn: 这条路穿过田野。
words.en: If an issue or problem cuts across different groups of people, it affects or matters to all those groups.

words.tr: 短语动词. 随着（音乐）跳舞；听从（某人）的指挥或摆布
words.ex: The children dance to the music.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们随着音乐跳舞。
words.en: To move rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr: phrase. 敢于做某事
words.ex: He dares to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他敢在全班面前说话。
words.en: To have the courage to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；始于（某一时期）
words.ex: These old coins date from the year 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧硬币可以追溯到1800年。
words.en: If something dates from a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 日复一日
words.ex: He works hard day after day.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens day after day, it happens every day without changing.

words.tr: phrase. 处理；应付
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 就……进行辩论；讨论
words.ex: The committee will debate on the new policy tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 委员会将在明天对新政策进行辩论。
words.en: Discuss or argue about a subject formally.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.tr: phrase. 对…作出决定
words.ex: They decide on the color for the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定房间的颜色。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 就…作出决定；选定
words.ex: The committee will decide upon the new policy next week.
words.ex_cn: 委员会将在下周对新政策作出决定。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully about it.

words.tr: phrase. 公开反对；声明反对
words.ex: They declare against the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他们宣布反对新规则。
words.en: To state publicly that one is opposed to something.

words.tr: v. 致力；
words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.tr: v. 防御；辩护；
words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；取决于
words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: n. 押金；存款；
words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于...； 由...传下来
words.ex: This village descends from a small fishing town.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄起源于一个小型渔村。
words.en: To have a particular person or group as your ancestors.

words.tr: v. 描述
words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.tr: phrase. 发展成；成长为；逐渐变成
words.ex: The small town will develop into a big city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇将发展成一座大城市。
words.en: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr: phrase. 把……奉献给……；致力于……（通常用于表达将时间、精力、资源等投入到某事或某人）
words.ex: He devotes two hours to reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天花两个小时读书。
words.en: To give all or a large part of your time or resources to a person, activity, or cause.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；变弱
words.ex: The sound of the bell died away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 铃声渐渐消失了。
words.en: If a sound dies away, it gradually becomes weaker or quieter and then stops completely.

words.tr: phrase. 不同
words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.tr: phrasal verb. 深入研究；探究；开始认真吃（食物）
words.ex: He dug into his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始认真做作业。
words.en: To investigate or examine something thoroughly; to start eating something eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. 区分，辨别……之间的不同
words.ex: It's important to distinguish between fact and opinion.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是要区分事实和观点。
words.en: To recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速把手伸进；溜进；一心投入
words.ex: He dove into the pocket to grab his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速把手伸进口袋去拿钥匙。
words.en: To start doing something suddenly and energetically, often without thinking about it first.

words.tr: phrase. 把…分成…
words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate something into parts or sections.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 伤害；损害
words.ex: Smoking can do harm to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对你的肺造成伤害。
words.en: To cause damage or injury to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 没有...也行；无需
words.ex: We can do without sugar in our coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们咖啡里可以不加糖。
words.en: To manage or survive without something that one would like to have.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；
words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.tr: phrase. 许多的；数十个
words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 得出结论；下结论
words.ex: He drew a conclusion after the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验后得出结论。
words.en: To come to a judgment or decision after considering the facts.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 梦见；梦想；向往
words.ex: I dream about flying every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都梦见在飞行。
words.en: To have a series of thoughts, images, or emotions occurring during sleep, or to think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 梦见；渴望
words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （数量、水平、兴趣等）逐渐减少，下降，消失
words.ex: The crowd started to drop away when it began to rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时人群开始散去了。
words.en: To gradually decrease or disappear.

words.tr: phrase. 不参与；退出
words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr: phrase. 不参与；退出
words.ex: He decided to drop out of the game because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了决定不参与比赛。
words.en: To leave a school, college, or course of study before you have finished it.

words.tr: phrase. 干透； 戒酒
words.ex: The clothes will dry out in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服在阳光下会晾干。
words.en: To remove the moisture from something or to stop drinking alcohol after a period of heavy drinking.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；应归于
words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 互相；彼此
words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生；维持生计
words.ex: He earns a living by driving a taxi.
words.ex_cn: 他靠开出租车谋生。
words.en: To earn a living means to make enough money to support oneself, typically through employment or business.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生
words.ex: He earns his living by fixing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他靠修车谋生。
words.en: To earn one's living means to make enough money to support oneself and one's family, typically through work.

words.tr: phrase. 放松；减轻；减少力度或强度
words.ex: The doctor advised him to ease off on his workload.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议他减轻工作量。
words.en: If something eases off, or if you ease it off, it becomes less strong, intense, or severe.

words.tr: phrase. 收回前言；承认自己说错了话
words.ex: He said I would never learn English, but now he has to eat his words.
words.ex_cn: 他说我永远学不会英语，但现在他不得不收回他的话。
words.en: To admit that what you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 吃光
words.ex: The dog ate up all the food.
words.ex_cn: 狗把所有的食物都吃光了。
words.en: To consume all of something, especially food.

words.tr: phrase. 不是…就是…；…或…；要么…要么…
words.ex: You can either stay or go.
words.ex_cn: 你要么留下，要么离开。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. 以…告终
words.ex: He forgot his money, so he ended up with nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钱，结果什么也没有。
words.en: To eventually be in a particular situation or place, often without intending to.

words.tr: phrase. 享受；过得快乐
words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.tr: phrase.  报名参加
words.ex: He will enter for the competition next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将报名参加下周的比赛。
words.en: To officially register or apply to participate in a competition, event, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 即使在……的同时；正当……之时
words.ex: He smiled even as he cried.
words.ex_cn: 他一边哭一边笑。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens at the same time as something else.

words.tr: phrase. 即使
words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管
words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.tr: phrase. 自从；自…以后
words.ex: He has been happy ever since he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 自从他搬到城市以来，他一直很快乐。
words.en: From a particular time in the past until the present.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔；有时；不时
words.ex: He visits his grandparents every now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you say that something happens every now and then or every so often, you mean that it happens occasionally but not very often.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔；有时；不时
words.ex: Every now and again, I like to go for a long walk in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 偶尔，我喜欢去乡村里长时间散步。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 每隔；所有其他
words.ex: He goes to the gym every other day.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一天去一次健身房。
words.en: You use every other to indicate that an action or event happens regularly, with a fixed period of time between each one and the next.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外；若不是
words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: v. 存在；生存；活着；
words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.tr: phrase. 使暴露于……；使接触……；使面临……
words.ex: Don't expose your skin to the sun too long.
words.ex_cn: 不要让你的皮肤暴露在阳光下太久。
words.en: To expose someone or something to a particular risk or influence means to put them in a situation where they might be harmed or affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面地
words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；慢慢减弱
words.ex: The music fades away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 音乐慢慢消失了。
words.en: To gradually disappear or become less noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 爱上
words.ex: He falls in love with her when he sees her smile.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到她的微笑时，他就爱上了她。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；被绊倒；翻倒
words.ex: The boy falls over and cries.
words.ex_cn: 男孩摔倒了，哭了。
words.en: To fall over means to fall to the ground or to fall down from an upright position.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；拖欠
words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；一点也不
words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.tr: phrase. 过于；实在太
words.ex: The movie was far too long for my taste.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对我来说太长了。
words.en: Far too is used to emphasize that something is more than is desirable, necessary, or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为食；以…为能源
words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.tr: phrase. 想要；感觉像；觉得
words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 小心翼翼地前进；摸索着前进；试探性地行事
words.ex: In the dark room, he had to feel his way to the door.
words.ex_cn: 在黑暗的房间里，他得摸索着找到门。
words.en: To proceed cautiously and carefully, especially in an unfamiliar situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: phrase. 查明；弄清
words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 首先
words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 决定；选定；专注于
words.ex: I finally fixed on a color for my room.
words.ex_cn: 我最终决定了房间的颜色。
words.en: If you fix on a particular thing, you decide that it is the one you want or will have.

words.tr: phrase. 选定；决定；注视于
words.ex: He fixed upon the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他选定了红色衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: To decide on or choose something after consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 集中于；专注于
words.ex: She decided to focus upon her career after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 她决定毕业后专注于自己的事业。
words.en: To direct one's attention or effort towards something specific.

words.tr: phrase. 免费
words.ex: You can download this app for free.
words.ex_cn: 你可以免费下载这个应用。
words.en: Without payment or charge; free of cost.

words.tr: phrase. 出售；待售
words.ex: The bike is for sale.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车待售。
words.en: If something is for sale, it is being offered to people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: phrase. 暂时
words.ex: He is living with his parents for the time being.
words.ex_cn: 他目前和父母住在一起。
words.en: For the time being means for the present, until some other arrangement is made.

words.tr: phrase. 从…释放出来；使摆脱；免于；不受影响
words.ex: The water is free from pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这种水没有污染。
words.en: To release or liberate someone or something from a particular constraint or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 有时；不时
words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 被理解；讲清楚
words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr: phrase. 相处
words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 进展；相处；上车
words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 相处；进展
words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 相处融洽
words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逃离；摆脱；离开
words.ex: He wants to get away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想逃离喧闹的城市。
words.en: To escape from a place or a situation.

words.tr: phrase. v. （做坏事而）逃脱惩罚，侥幸成功
words.ex: He stole the money but got away with it.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了钱，但没有被发现。
words.en: To avoid being punished for something wrong that one has done.

words.tr: phrase. 着手做；开始认真做
words.ex: He got down to work after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后开始认真工作。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something seriously or with determination.

words.tr: 短语动词. 取得联系；与...联络
words.ex: Please get in touch if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，请联系我。
words.en: To communicate with someone, especially by phone or email, in order to give or receive information.

words.tr: phrase. 和...取得联系
words.ex: Please get in touch with me if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请与我联系。
words.en: To make contact or communicate with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；卷入；参与
words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 下车；离开
words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.tr: phrase. 进展；相处；上车
words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 摆脱； 除去
words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 被卡住；被困住
words.ex: He gets stuck in traffic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都堵车。
words.en: To be unable to move or to be fixed in a particular position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…厌烦
words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same thing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的事情。
words.en: To become weary or lose patience with something due to overexposure or repetition.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.tr: phrase. 投降；屈服；让步
words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 发出（蒸汽、光等）
words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gave me a lift to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他载我去车站。
words.en: To take someone somewhere in your car, especially when they need help getting there.

words.tr: phrase. 怒视；瞪眼看着
words.ex: He glares at the boy because the boy took his pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他怒视那个男孩，因为男孩拿了他的铅笔。
words.en: To look at someone or something in an angry way.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；违反；不利于
words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 前进；继续；进行
words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. 节食
words.ex: She decided to go on a diet to lose weight before her wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在婚礼前节食减肥。
words.en: To start eating less or different kinds of food in order to lose weight or for health reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 最好
words.ex: You had better finish your homework before going out.
words.ex_cn: 你最好在出门前完成你的作业。
words.en: used to tell someone what you think they should do

words.tr: phrasal verb. 归还；交还
words.ex: Please hand back the book after you finish reading it.
words.ex_cn: 读完后请把书交还。
words.en: To return something to the person who gave it to you, especially after you have used it or borrowed it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；徘徊；无所事事地待着
words.ex: They like to hang about after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢放学后闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any real purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 一……就……（用于表示某事几乎一发生，另一事紧接着发生）
words.ex: I had hardly sat down when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 我刚一坐下，电话就响了。
words.en: used to say that something happens immediately after something else

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr: phrase. 上课；有课程
words.ex: I have classes every Monday and Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一和周三都有课。
words.en: To attend or be engaged in a session of instruction in a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 感冒；伤风
words.ex: He has a cold and stays at home.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，待在家里。
words.en: To suffer from a minor illness that makes you sneeze and cough and gives you a sore throat.

words.tr: 短语动词，有……的天赋；擅长于……
words.ex: He has a gift for drawing animals.
words.ex_cn: 他有画动物的天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability to do something well.

words.tr: phrase. 尝试一下；试一试（做某事）
words.ex: I will have a go at solving this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我会试着解这道数学题。
words.en: To attempt or try something.

words.tr: phrase. 玩得开心
words.ex: They have a good time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园玩得很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to spend time in a pleasant way

words.tr: 短语. 玩得愉快；过得开心
words.ex: I hope you have a great time at the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你今晚在派对上玩得开心。
words.en: To enjoy oneself very much.

words.tr: phrase. v. 参与；插手；在……中起作用
words.ex: He has a hand in organizing the school party.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校派对的组织工作。
words.en: To be involved in or have influence over something.

words.tr: 短语动词，拥有……的人口数量
words.ex: The small town has a population of 5,000 people.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有5000人的人口。
words.en: To possess a certain number of people living in a specific area.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对...有发言权；参与...的决策
words.ex: Employees should have a say in the decision-making process.
words.ex_cn: 员工应该在决策过程中有发言权。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to express one's opinion or influence a decision.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尝一尝；体验一下
words.ex: He wanted to have a taste of the local cuisine.
words.ex_cn: 他想尝尝当地的菜肴。
words.en: To try a small amount of food or drink to see what it is like; to experience something briefly.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发烧；体温升高
words.ex: If you have a temperature, it's best to stay at home and rest.
words.ex_cn: 如果你发烧了，最好待在家里休息。
words.en: To have a body temperature that is higher than normal, often due to illness.

words.tr: phrase. 与...交谈
words.ex: I will have a word with him about his noise.
words.ex_cn: 我会跟他谈谈他的噪音问题。
words.en: To speak to someone briefly, especially in order to give them a warning or to tell them something important.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…有强烈欲望；渴望；喜爱（尤指食物或某种活动）
words.ex: He has an appetite for adventure.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢冒险。
words.en: To have a strong desire or liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响
words.ex: Smoking has an effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有影响。
words.en: To cause a change or influence something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有鉴赏力；善于发现……的美或价值
words.ex: She has an eye for beautiful clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她对漂亮的衣服很敏感。
words.en: If you have an eye for something, you are good at noticing it or you have a natural ability to appreciate it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响；对…起作用；产生效果
words.ex: Smoking has an impact on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 想要做某事；渴望做某事
words.ex: He has a desire to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他有学习英语的愿望。
words.en: To want to do something very much.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在……方面有困难
words.ex: He has difficulty in understanding math.
words.ex_cn: 他在理解数学方面有困难。
words.en: To experience problems or obstacles in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 相信；信任
words.ex: I have faith in you to do the right thing.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你会做正确的事。
words.en: To believe in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.

words.tr: 玩得高兴，过得快活; 耍笑; 玩耍
words.ex: They have fun playing soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后踢足球很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to experience pleasure and enjoyment

words.tr: 短语动词. 与……一起玩得愉快；从……中获得乐趣
words.ex: I have fun with my friends at the park.
words.ex_cn: 我和朋友们在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To enjoy oneself or engage in an activity for amusement and pleasure.

words.tr: phrase. 必须；不得不
words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天必须去上学。
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 不得不；必须
words.ex: I have got to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate necessity or obligation.

words.tr: phrase. 有共同之处
words.ex: They have music in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同的爱好是音乐。
words.en: If two or more people or things have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences, or have similar characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有影响；对……起作用
words.ex: Parents have influence on their children's habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的习惯有影响。
words.en: To affect or change how someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响
words.ex: Parents can have an influence on their children's habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母可以影响孩子的习惯。
words.en: To affect or change how someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks.

words.tr: phrase. 与...有点关系
words.ex: This problem may have something to do with the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题可能和天气有关。
words.en: to be related to or connected with something

words.tr: phrase. 有心事；心里惦记着某事
words.ex: He has something on his mind and looks very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 他心里有事，看起来很安静。
words.en: To be thinking about something a lot, especially because you are worried about it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有现货；备有某物
words.ex: The shop has some red apples in stock.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有红苹果存货。
words.en: If a shop has something in stock, it has that item available to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 有事要做；有事情要处理
words.ex: I have something to do this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我有些事情要做。
words.en: If you say that one thing has something to do with another, you mean that the two things are connected in some way.

words.tr: 短语. 做某事有困难
words.ex: He has trouble doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业有困难。
words.en: If you have trouble doing something, you find it difficult to do.

words.tr: 短语. 做某事有困难；在做某事方面遇到麻烦
words.ex: I have trouble in understanding the advanced concepts of physics.
words.ex_cn: v. 我在理解物理的高级概念时遇到困难。
words.en: To experience difficulty or problems in doing something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人争吵或发生口角
words.ex: He had words with his neighbor about the noisy dog.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吵闹的狗和邻居吵了一架。
words.en: To argue or have a disagreement with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 听说
words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.tr: phrase. 听说
words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 全心全意；核心部分；灵魂与心灵
words.ex: She devoted herself to the project heart and soul.
words.ex_cn: 她全心全意地投入到这个项目中。
words.en: If you put your heart and soul into something, you do it with a great deal of enthusiasm and energy.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随意享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随便吃些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To serve oneself with food or drink without waiting to be served by someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随便享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随意吃一些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To take something for oneself without asking for permission, often used when offering something to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助解决困难
words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.tr: 动词短语，帮助某人做某事；在某方面协助某人
words.ex: She offered to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 她主动提出帮我做作业。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something.

words.tr: 短语. 给你；这就是你要的东西（用于递东西给别人时）
words.ex: Here you are, your algebra book.
words.ex_cn: 给你，你的代数书。
words.en: A phrase used to hand something to someone, meaning 'This is for you.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现
words.ex: I hit on a great cafe while walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园散步时偶然发现了一家很棒的咖啡馆。
words.en: To suddenly have a good idea or to flirt with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔发现；偶然想到；碰巧选择
words.ex: He hit upon a simple solution after thinking for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他想了几个小时后想出了一个简单的解决方案。
words.en: If you hit upon an idea or a solution, you think of it suddenly or by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
