words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: 短语. ……怎么样；……好吗（用于提出建议或征求对方意见）
words.ex: How about we go to the park?
words.ex_cn: 我们去公园怎么样？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to ask for someone's opinion

words.tr: phrase. 多远；到什么程度
words.ex: How far is it from here to the station?
words.ex_cn: 从这里到车站有多远？
words.en: Used to ask about the distance to a place or the extent or degree to which something happens or is true.

words.tr: phrase. 多久
words.ex: How long does it take to walk to school?
words.ex_cn: 走路去学校要多久？
words.en: used to ask about the duration of time

words.tr: phrase. 数百的；大量的
words.ex: Hundreds of students came to the event.
words.ex_cn: 有数百名学生参加了这个活动。
words.en: Used to emphasize a large but indefinite number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找；搜寻
words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙进入；仓促投入
words.ex: He had to hurry into the classroom when the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 当铃声响起时，他不得不赶紧跑进教室。
words.en: To move or act with haste; to do something quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 赶紧；快点
words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 要是…就好了
words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.tr: adj. 可能的
words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 使…铭记；向…强调；把…强加于
words.ex: The teacher tries to impress on students the importance of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 老师努力让学生记住努力的重要性。
words.en: To make someone understand or recognize the importance or value of something.

words.tr: phrase. 使对…留下深刻印象；因…而钦佩
words.ex: He tries to impress with his singing.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用他的歌声给人留下印象。
words.en: To make someone feel admiration or respect because of something you have done or said.

words.tr: v. 改善；改进；提高；
words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr: phrase. 改进；在…基础上加以改良；对…做出更好的版本
words.ex: Scientists are constantly trying to improve upon existing technologies.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们不断尝试改进现有技术。
words.en: To make something better than it was before.

words.tr: phrase. 左右为难
words.ex: He is in a dilemma about which job to take.
words.ex_cn: 他正陷入两难，不知道该选哪份工作。
words.en: In a difficult situation where a choice has to be made between two or more alternatives that are equally undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 瞬间地；立刻；一眨眼功夫
words.ex: He disappeared in a flash.
words.ex_cn: 他瞬间就消失了。
words.en: If you say that something happens in a flash, you mean that it happens suddenly and lasts only a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙；乐意地
words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙地；急忙地；在赶时间
words.ex: He is in a rush to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a rush, you are trying to do something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；一会儿
words.ex: I'll be with you in a moment.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我马上就来。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in a moment, you mean that it will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 简而言之；用一句话概括
words.ex: In a nutshell, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: If you say something in a nutshell, you are describing it or explaining it in a very brief way, using just a few words.

words.tr: phrase. 成一排；连续
words.ex: The books are placed in a row on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地摆成一排放在书架上。
words.en: If something happens several times in a row, it happens that number of times without a break.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度
words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.tr: phrase. 低声地；悄声地；以耳语的方式
words.ex: They spoke in a whisper so as not to wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他们低声说话以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you say something in a whisper, you say it very quietly.

words.tr: phrase. 低声地；悄悄地；小声地
words.ex: They spoke in whispers so as not to wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他们低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, so that only people close to one can hear.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；一句话
words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.tr: phrase. 与...一致；按照
words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 另外；也
words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 与……一致；同意；符合
words.ex: He is in agreement with his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他和老师意见一致。
words.en: In accordance with; consistent with.

words.tr: phrase. 为了帮助；为了支持；为……筹款
words.ex: The charity concert was held in aid of the earthquake victims.
words.ex_cn: 这场慈善音乐会是为了帮助地震受害者而举办的。
words.en: For the purpose of supporting or helping someone or something.

words.tr: phrase.  一共；总计
words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.tr: phrase. 惊奇地；惊愕地；处于震惊之中
words.ex: He stared at the magic trick in amazement.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: With a feeling of great surprise or wonder; in a state of astonishment.

words.tr: phrase. 作为对…的回应；回答；应…之请求
words.ex: He spoke in answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他回答了这个问题。
words.en: As a response to or in reply to something.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；总之
words.ex: In any case, we should proceed with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们应该继续执行这个计划。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; whatever the situation is or will be.

words.tr: phrase. 为感谢…；为表彰…；出于对…的赞赏
words.ex: He received a gift in appreciation of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一份礼物，以感谢他的辛勤工作。
words.en: used to express gratitude or thanks for something someone has done

words.tr: phrase. 在战斗中；在战役里；处于交战状态
words.ex: He showed great courage in battle.
words.ex_cn: 他在战斗中表现出了极大的勇气。
words.en: Engaged in or during a fight or war between opposing forces.

words.tr: phrase. 简单地说；简而言之；简单扼要地
words.ex: In brief, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: In a few words; concisely.

words.tr: phrase. 万一；以防
words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.tr: phrase. 用现金；以现金方式
words.ex: He paid in cash for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了这本书。
words.en: Using physical money rather than a credit card or check.

words.tr: phrase. 为庆祝……；为了庆祝……
words.ex: They held a party in celebration of their anniversary.
words.ex_cn: 他们举行了一个派对来庆祝他们的周年纪念。
words.en: If something is in celebration of a particular event, it is intended to celebrate that event.

words.tr: phrase. /prep. 负责；主管；掌管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责管理教室。
words.en: Having the responsibility for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；主管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 共有
words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 在他人面前；当众；一起；结伴
words.ex: They decided to travel in company for safety.
words.ex_cn: 为了安全起见，他们决定结伴旅行。
words.en: When someone is in company, they are accompanied by someone else or are in a social setting with others.

words.tr: phrase. 与…比较起来
words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相比；相较于
words.ex: He runs faster in comparison to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 与他哥哥相比，他跑得更快。
words.en: Used when you are comparing two things, people, or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；最后；综上所述
words.ex: In conclusion, we should eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 总之，我们应该多吃蔬菜。
words.en: used to introduce the final comments at the end of a speech or a piece of writing

words.tr: phrase. 处于……状态；处于……状况
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: In a particular state or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 私下地；秘密地；作为机密地
words.ex: She told me about her plans in confidence.
words.ex_cn: 她私下里告诉我她的计划。
words.en: If you tell someone something in confidence, you tell them something secret or private and you trust them not to tell anyone else.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；和...形成对照
words.ex: He likes coffee, in contrast to his sister who likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，而他的妹妹喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 处于控制之中；掌握局势；能控制局面
words.ex: He is in control of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这辆车。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: phrase. 掌控；控制；管理；支配
words.ex: She is in control of the situation.
words.ex_cn: 她控制着局面。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: phrase. 在危险中；垂危
words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 欠债
words.ex: He is in debt because he bought a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因为买了一辆车而欠债。
words.en: owing money to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 非常需要的；销路好的
words.ex: Good teachers are in demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is in demand, they are wanted or required by a lot of people.

words.tr: phrase. 详细地
words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 伪装；化装
words.ex: The man was in disguise at the party.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人在聚会上乔装打扮。
words.en: Concealed or disguised; not in one's true form or identity.

words.tr: phrase. 有效；实际上
words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.tr: phrase. 用英语；在英语方面
words.ex: Can you say it in english?
words.ex_cn: 你能用英语说一下吗？
words.en: In the language that originated in England and is now used in many countries.

words.tr: phrase. 错误地；由于差错；无意中
words.ex: He sent the email in error.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地发送了那封电子邮件。
words.en: If something is done in error, it is done mistakenly or incorrectly.

words.tr: phrase. 作为交换；作为回报
words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for my old one.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我那本旧的。
words.en: If you give or receive something in exchange, you give or receive it as part of a deal or agreement in which you give or receive something else in return.

words.tr: phrase. 现存的；存在的；仍然活着的
words.ex: The oldest tree in the world is still in existence.
words.ex_cn: 世界上最古老的树仍然存在。
words.en: Currently existing or being in the present state.

words.tr: phrase. 面对
words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上；实际上
words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同；支持；有利于
words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 有效的；在实施中的；大批的；大规模的
words.ex: The new law is still in force.
words.ex_cn: 新法律仍然有效。
words.en: If something such as a law, rule, or system is in force, it is operating or being used.

words.tr: phrase. 在…前面；在…面前；领先于
words.ex: The car in front suddenly stopped.
words.ex_cn: 前面的车突然停了下来。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 在...前面
words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 今后；往后
words.ex: In future, I will be more careful with my spending.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会更加小心我的开支。
words.en: From now on; at a future time.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 在手头；在掌握中；在进行中；在控制下
words.ex: I have enough cash in hand to pay for the tickets.
words.ex_cn: 我手头有足够的现金来支付票钱。
words.en: If you have something in hand, you have it available for use or you are dealing with it.

words.tr: phrase. 和睦；协调
words.ex: The birds sing in harmony with the wind.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿与风一起和谐地歌唱。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing because all the parts seem to fit together well.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 向...表示敬意；为祝贺...
words.ex: They planted a tree in honor of her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她的生日。
words.en: If something is arranged or happens in honor of a particular event or person, it is done to celebrate that event or to show respect and admiration for that person.

words.tr: phrase. 住院
words.ex: He is in hospital recovering from surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他住院接受手术后的康复治疗。
words.en: Being in a hospital as a patient.

words.tr: phrase. 成一直线；一致；协调；有秩序
words.ex: The books are placed in line on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地排成一条直线放在书架上。
words.en: If people or things are in line, they are arranged in a line or a row.

words.tr: phrase. 纪念；追念
words.ex: They planted a tree in memory of her.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她。
words.en: If you do something in memory of a dead person, you do it as a way of showing that you want to remember them and that you respect them.

words.tr: phrase. 在世界上；实际上；本质上
words.ex: Dolphins in nature are very smart.
words.ex_cn: 世界上海豚非常聪明。
words.en: In the essential character of something; in reality.

words.tr: phrase. 处于困境中；需要帮助（或救济）的
words.ex: He is in need of help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助。
words.en: If someone is in need, they are very poor and require help.

words.tr: phrase. 需要
words.ex: He is in need of help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If someone or something is in need of something, they need it.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；在任何情况下都不
words.ex: In no case should you give up your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不应该放弃你的梦想。
words.en: Under no circumstances; never.

words.tr: phrase. 不着急；从容不迫；不急于
words.ex: He's in no hurry to make a decision.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 他不急于做决定。
words.en: phrase. Not in a rush or eager to do something immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；马上
words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人看来
words.ex: In my opinion, the movie is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常好。
words.en: Used to express someone's personal view or belief about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人看来
words.ex: In my view, learning English is very important.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，学习英语非常重要。
words.en: From someone's perspective or opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人视线范围内；在某人眼前；被某人看见
words.ex: Keep the baby in your sight at all times.
words.ex_cn: 时刻让宝宝在你的视线范围内。
words.en: From someone's point of view; as someone sees it.

words.tr: phrase. 轮到某人时；依次；按顺序轮到某人
words.ex: Each student will speak in one's turn.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生将依次发言。
words.en: When it is someone's turn to do something, they do it after someone else has done it and before others do it.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 为了；以便于
words.ex: He studies hard in order that he can pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以便能通过考试。
words.en: used to introduce a clause indicating the purpose of an action or event.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr: phrase. 换句话说
words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 成对地；两人一组地；成双地
words.ex: The students were asked to work in pairs.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被要求成对地工作。
words.en: In twos; two at a time.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 平静地；安宁地；和平地；安详地
words.ex: The cat sleeps in peace on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发上安静地睡觉。
words.en: In a state of harmony or tranquility, without conflict or disturbance.

words.tr: phrase. 亲自；外貌上
words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的位置；适当
words.ex: The books are in place on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地放在书架上。
words.en: In the correct position or location; ready for use.

words.tr: phrase. 代替
words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有；持有
words.ex: He is in possession of a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一辆新自行车。
words.en: Having or holding something as one's own.

words.tr: phrase. 在实践中；实际上
words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 赞扬；歌颂；为颂扬…而作
words.ex: Many articles have been written in praise of her achievements.
words.ex_cn: 许多文章赞扬了她的成就。
words.en: If you write or say something in praise of someone or something, you write or say that you admire them or approve of them.

words.tr: phrase. 优先于；比起…更喜欢；而不是
words.ex: He chose tea in preference to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他选择茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you choose one thing in preference to another, you choose it instead of the other thing because you like it better.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密地；私下
words.ex: He talks to his dog in private.
words.ex_cn: 他私下跟他的狗说话。
words.en: If you do something in private, you do it without other people being present, often because it is something that you want to keep secret.

words.tr: phrase. 公开地；当众
words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.tr: phrase. 衣衫褴褛地；穿着破旧衣服地
words.ex: The old man was in rags after losing his home.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人失去家园后衣衫褴褛。
words.en: Wearing very old and torn clothes.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上
words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.tr: phrase. 为表彰…；为认可…；作为对…的承认
words.ex: The award was given in recognition of her outstanding contributions to science.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖项是为了表彰她在科学领域的杰出贡献。
words.en: as a way of showing appreciation or gratitude for something someone has done.

words.tr: phrase. 如释重负地；明显地；浮雕般地
words.ex: He sighed in relief when the exam was over.
words.ex_cn: 考试结束时，他松了一口气。
words.en: A sculptural technique where figures are raised from a flat background, creating a three-dimensional effect on a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 对…做出反应
words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: phrase. 作为报答
words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase.  成为废墟地；破败不堪
words.ex: The old castle is in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的城堡已成废墟。
words.en: In a state of severe decay or destruction, often due to neglect or disaster.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找
words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.tr: phrase. 当季；正当时；处于旺季
words.ex: Apples are in season in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天是当季的。
words.en: If a fruit or vegetable is in season, it is the time of year when it is ready for eating and is widely available.

words.tr: phrase. 健康；在外形上；处于良好状态
words.ex: He runs every day to stay in shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持健康。
words.en: In good physical condition; healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 简而言之；总之
words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 在视野内；看得见；在望；临近
words.ex: The boat is in sight of the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船在岸边的视野内。
words.en: If something is in sight, it is in a position where you can see it.

words.tr: 安静地，无声地
words.ex: He sat in silence while the teacher spoke.
words.ex_cn: 老师讲话时，他静静地坐着。
words.en: Without speaking or making any noise.

words.tr: phrase. 在某些情况下；有时
words.ex: In some cases, he forgets his keys.
words.ex_cn: 在某些情况下，他会忘记带钥匙。
words.en: Under certain circumstances or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 不顾；不管；尽管
words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 贮藏着；准备着；保存着
words.ex: There is a surprise in store for you.
words.ex_cn: 为你准备了一个惊喜。
words.en: If something is in store for you, it is going to happen to you in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 总言之；大体上
words.ex: In sum, he did a good job.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他做得很好。
words.en: In sum is used to introduce a summary or conclusion, indicating that what follows is a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；支援
words.ex: He spoke in support of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他为朋友说话支持。
words.en: If you do something in support of someone or something, you do it in order to help them or to show that you agree with their aims or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 惊讶地
words.ex: He looked at me in surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地看着我。
words.en: In a manner that shows you are surprised or startled by something.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.tr: phrase. 抽象地；理论上；从概念上说
words.ex: He thinks about justice in the abstract.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽象的角度思考正义。
words.en: In a general or theoretical sense, without reference to specific examples.

words.tr: phrase. 在……领域；在……方面；大约……
words.ex: She has extensive experience in the area of environmental science.
words.ex_cn: 她在环境科学领域有丰富的经验。
words.en: In the context of a particular field or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决；处于紧要关头；结果未定
words.ex: The future of the project remains in the balance.
words.ex_cn: 项目的未来仍悬而未决。
words.en: If something is in the balance, it is uncertain whether it will happen or succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 起初
words.ex: In the beginning, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the start or origin of something.

words.tr: phrase. 由…负责；由…照管；在…的管理之下
words.ex: The project is in the charge of a capable manager.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目由一位能干的管理者负责。
words.en: Being managed or supervised by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的陪伴下；与…在一起
words.ex: She enjoyed her time in the company of friends.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢和朋友在一起的时光。
words.en: If you are in the company of someone, you are with them.

words.tr: phrase. 在...期间
words.ex: He found his keys in the course of cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他在打扫房间的过程中找到了钥匙。
words.en: During the process or period of something happening.

words.tr: phrase. 在远处；在远方
words.ex: We saw a castle in the distance.
words.ex_cn: 我们在远处看到了一座城堡。
words.en: At a point that is far away.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；终于
words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.tr: phrase. 本人；亲自；活生生地；在实际生活中（而非照片、影像或想象中）
words.ex: I saw my favorite singer in the flesh at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 我在音乐会上亲眼见到了我最喜欢的歌手。
words.en: If you meet or see someone in the flesh, you actually meet or see them, rather than, for example, seeing them on television or in a photograph.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的形式；呈……形状；以……方式
words.ex: The answer is in the form of a number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是以数字的形式给出的。
words.en: used to indicate the way in which something is done or presented

words.tr: phrase. 在将来；日后
words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.tr: phrase. 在……的历史中；在……的历史上
words.ex: In the history of math, algebra was invented long ago.
words.ex_cn: 在数学史上，代数很早就被发明了。
words.en: Throughout the recorded or known past of a particular subject or field.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着……的希望；期望能够；以期
words.ex: He waited outside the house in the hope of seeing her.
words.ex_cn: 他在房子外面等着，希望能见到她。
words.en: with the desire or expectation that something will happen

words.tr: phrase. 丝毫；一点也（不）；在任何程度上
words.ex: She wasn't in the least bit interested in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 她对那部电影一点也不感兴趣。
words.en: not at all; in the smallest degree

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；最后
words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: n. 与此同时；
words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的中间
words.ex: He stopped walking in the middle of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他在路中间停了下来。
words.en: If you are in the middle of doing something, you are busy doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 有心情做…；想…；对…有兴趣
words.ex: I'm in the mood for a quiet evening at home.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想在家安静地度过。
words.en: If you are in the mood for something, you feel like doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 在户外；在露天
words.ex: The children play in the open air every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午在户外玩耍。
words.en: Outdoors; not inside a building.

words.tr: phrase. 妨碍；挡道
words.ex: The box is in the way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡路了。
words.en: If something or someone is in the way, they prevent you from moving or from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 挡着某人的路；妨碍某人；按某人自己的方式
words.ex: Please move the bag; it is in my way.
words.ex_cn: 请把包移开；它挡了我的路。
words.en: If someone or something is in your way, they are preventing you from moving or from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 世界上；究竟
words.ex: He is the best player in the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是世界上最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize the question of what exists or happens in the world, or to emphasize a superlative.

words.tr: phrase. 理论上
words.ex: In theory, the plan works well.
words.ex_cn: 理论上，这个计划效果很好。
words.en: If you say that something is true in theory, you mean that it is supposed to be true according to a set of ideas or principles, but in practice it may not be true.

words.tr: phrase. 这样；用这种方式
words.ex: She solved the problem in this way.
words.ex_cn: 她这样解决了问题。
words.en: By means of this method or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 及时
words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.tr: phrase. 总共
words.ex: There are 5 apples and 3 oranges, in total 8 fruits.
words.ex_cn: 有5个苹果和3个橙子，总共8个水果。
words.en: as a whole; including everything or everyone

words.tr: phrase. 处于困境
words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而陷入麻烦。
words.en: In a situation that is difficult or dangerous.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 使用中
words.ex: This tool is in use right now.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具现在正在使用中。
words.en: Currently being used or occupied.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.tr: phrase. 鉴于；考虑到；由于
words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.tr: phrase. 需要；缺乏；缺少
words.ex: The project is in want of additional funding.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目需要额外的资金。
words.en: If you are in want of something, you need it or do not have enough of it.

words.tr: phrase. 增加到；提升至
words.ex: The price will increase to $10.
words.ex_cn: 价格将涨到10美元。
words.en: To become or make something greater in amount, number, value, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 从…推断；由…得出结论
words.ex: We can infer from the data that the trend is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以从数据中推导出趋势正在上升。
words.en: To conclude or deduce something from evidence and reasoning rather than from explicit statements.

words.tr: phrase. 次于；劣于
words.ex: This phone is inferior to the one I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机不如我去年买的那部。
words.en: If one thing is inferior to another, it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；坚决要求
words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持；坚决要求；执意要
words.ex: He insists upon finishing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要在吃晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.

words.tr: phrase. 代替；而不是
words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 携手；合作；联手；团结一致
words.ex: The two companies decided to join hands to tackle the market challenges.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司决定联手应对市场挑战。
words.en: To work together with someone in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；加入
words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.tr: phrase. 参军；入伍
words.ex: He decided to join the army after high school.
words.ex_cn: 高中毕业后，他决定参军。
words.en: join the army: to become a soldier by enlisting in the military.

words.tr: phrase. 联合起来；加入；会合；参军
words.ex: They decided to join up at the train station at 9 AM.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定早上9点在火车站碰面。
words.en: To connect or link together; to become a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 草草记下
words.ex: He likes to jot down ideas in his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把想法记在笔记本上。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.tr: phrase. 根据…来判断…；以…为标准评价…
words.ex: Don't judge a person by how they look.
words.ex_cn: 不要以貌取人。
words.en: To form an opinion about someone or something based on a particular characteristic or appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 根据…来判断；从…来看
words.ex: Judging by the weather, we should bring an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 根据天气来看，我们应该带把伞。
words.en: If you say that something is the case judging by or judging from a particular thing, you mean that it seems to be the case because of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 从……来判断；根据……来看
words.ex: Judging from his expression, he is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 从他的表情来看，他并不开心。
words.en: If you say that something is the case judging from a particular thing, you mean that it is the case based on that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 插队
words.ex: He tried to jump the queue, but others shouted at him.
words.ex_cn: 他想插队，但其他人对他大声喊叫。
words.en: To move ahead of others in a line or sequence without waiting for one's turn.

words.tr: phrase. 稍等一下；请稍等；马上就好
words.ex: Just a minute, I am coming.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就来。
words.en: A phrase used to ask someone to wait for a short period of time.

words.tr: n. 片刻；瞬间；
words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；正是；大约；马上
words.ex: I have just about finished my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我差不多快写完作业了。
words.en: Almost; very nearly.

words.tr: phrase. 刚刚
words.ex: He called me just now.
words.ex_cn: 他刚才给我打了电话。
words.en: A very short time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 正是如此；恰好如此；一丝不苟地；井然有序地
words.ex: Is the meeting at 3 p.m.? Just so.
words.ex_cn: 会议是三点吗？正是如此。
words.en: Arranged or done in a very neat and orderly manner.

words.tr: phrase. 就在那时；正当那时
words.ex: He was walking home, just then the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 他正走在回家的路上，就在那时电话响了。
words.en: At exactly that moment.

words.tr: phrase. 记录
words.ex: He keeps a record of every book he reads.
words.ex_cn: 他记录下自己读过的每一本书。
words.en: To maintain a written account or documentation of something.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；密切注视
words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 留意；密切注意；保持警惕
words.ex: Please keep an eye out for any suspicious activity.
words.ex_cn: 请留意任何可疑活动。
words.en: To remain alert or watchful for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 留意；密切注意；留心寻找
words.ex: Keep an eye out for the red bus at the corner.
words.ex_cn: 留意拐角处的红色公交车。
words.en: To watch carefully for someone or something to appear or to be careful about something.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；纠缠
words.ex: You need to keep at your studies if you want to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过考试，就需要坚持学习。
words.en: If you keep at something, you continue to do it or work on it, even though it is difficult or you are making slow progress.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；避开；使不接近
words.ex: Keep away from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 远离火。
words.en: To stay at a distance from someone or something, or to prevent someone or something from coming near.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；避开；不接近
words.ex: Keep away from the sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 远离那把锋利的刀。
words.en: To avoid someone or something; to stay at a distance from someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；隐瞒；留在后面
words.ex: He tried to keep back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To retain or withhold something, not allowing it to be seen, known, or used.

words.tr: phrase. 保持健康；健身
words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；妨碍；抑制
words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；防止；使免于；抑制
words.ex: She keeps her diary from her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她把日记藏起来不给弟弟看。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to stop something from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 谨记，牢记
words.ex: Keep this rule in mind when you write essays.
words.ex_cn: 当你写文章时，要记住这个规则。
words.en: If you keep something in mind, you remember it and take it into account in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 保持联系
words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持联系
words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持下去；继续保持；再接再厉
words.ex: Keep it up, you are doing great!
words.ex_cn: 继续加油，你做得很好！
words.en: To continue doing something well or to maintain a good standard of performance.

words.tr: phrase. 让开；不接近
words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做；持续做；不停地做
words.ex: He keeps on trying, even when it is hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他也在继续尝试。
words.en: To continue doing something without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 保持平衡；保持镇定；稳住身体
words.ex: He tries to keep his balance on the narrow bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在狭窄的桥上保持平衡。
words.en: To maintain one's equilibrium or stability, especially in a challenging or precarious situation.

words.tr: phrase. 紧盯着；密切注意；持续关注
words.ex: Keep your eyes on the ball when you are playing tennis.
words.ex_cn: 打网球时要盯着球。
words.en: To watch someone or something closely; to pay close attention to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；镇定自若
words.ex: He kept his head during the emergency.
words.ex_cn: 他在紧急情况下保持了冷静。
words.en: To remain calm and sensible in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 信守诺言；履行承诺
words.ex: He keeps his promise to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了帮助朋友的承诺。
words.en: To do what one said one would do; to fulfill one's commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 信守承诺
words.ex: He kept a promise to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他信守了帮助朋友的承诺。
words.en: To fulfill or make good on a promise that one has made.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: phrase. 不介入；远离；避开；置身……之外
words.ex: You should keep out of their arguments.
words.ex_cn: 你应该置身于他们的争论之外。
words.en: To avoid becoming involved in something or to prevent something from entering a place.

words.tr: phrase. 并驾齐驱
words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守；遵循；坚持
words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；继续；跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 中线开球；出发；开始；脱鞋
words.ex: The referee will kick off the match at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 裁判将在下午3点中线开球。
words.en: To start something, especially a game, event, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 杀光；消灭
words.ex: The disease killed off many animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病导致森林里的许多动物死亡。
words.en: To kill off means to cause the death of all members of a group or species, or to end something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: He reads comics to kill time.
words.ex_cn: 他看漫画来打发时间。
words.en: To spend time doing something that is not particularly useful or interesting, especially while waiting for something else to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 有点儿
words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 漫游；漂泊；闲逛；随意地击打或碰撞
words.ex: We just knock about the house on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们周末只是在家里闲逛。
words.en: To travel or move around without a specific purpose or direction, often in a casual or aimless manner.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；漫游；随意打发时间；虐待；殴打
words.ex: He likes to knock around the city on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末在城市里漫游。
words.en: To travel or move around without a specific purpose or destination; to discuss or consider something informally.

words.tr: phrase. 知道；了解；听说
words.ex: I know about cats and dogs.
words.ex_cn: 我知道关于猫和狗的事情。
words.en: To have information or understanding about something.

words.tr: phrase. 知道；听说过；对…有所耳闻
words.ex: I know of that movie, but I haven't seen it.
words.ex_cn: 我知道那部电影，但我没看过。
words.en: To be aware of the existence of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 熟记；牢记；背得滚瓜烂熟
words.ex: He knows the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗背得滚瓜烂熟。
words.en: To have memorized something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；辨别；能够分辨……与……
words.ex: I know the dog from the park.
words.ex_cn: 我能把这只狗和公园区分开来。
words.en: To be able to distinguish one thing or person from another.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏
words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.tr: phrase. 逢凶化吉；转危为安；摆脱困境后安然无恙
words.ex: After losing his job, he quickly found a better one. He always lands on his feet.
words.ex_cn: 失去工作后，他很快找到了更好的工作。他总是能逢凶化吉。
words.en: To successfully emerge from a difficult situation, often unexpectedly or by luck.

words.tr: phrase. 最后但同样重要的
words.ex: Last but not least, don't forget to bring your ID.
words.ex_cn: 最后但同样重要的是，别忘了带你的身份证。
words.en: used to say that the last person or thing mentioned is as important as the others

words.tr: phrase. 稍后；后来；之后
words.ex: He was tired, but he will study later on.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但他稍后会学习。
words.en: At a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 因…而发笑；嘲笑
words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.tr: phrase. 笑掉大牙；狂笑不止；笑到肚子疼
words.ex: We laughed our heads off at the funny movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们看那部有趣的电影时笑得前仰后合。
words.en: To laugh very hard or uncontrollably.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在一边；搁置；储蓄；抛弃
words.ex: He lay aside his book and stood up.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一边，站了起来。
words.en: To put something to one side, especially for a short time, in order to do something else.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；放弃；规定
words.ex: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被命令放下武器。
words.en: To lay something down means to put it down, often in a careful or deliberate way. It can also mean to establish something, such as rules or guidelines.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时解雇；停止
words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. v. 储存；使（船）入坞修理；使（人）卧床休养；暂停使用
words.ex: She decided to lay up some money for her retirement.
words.ex_cn: 她决定为退休储蓄一些钱。
words.en: To store or accumulate something for future use; to cause someone to be confined to bed due to illness or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 过……的生活；过着……的日子
words.ex: They lead a simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他们在乡下过着简单的生活。
words.en: To live a particular kind of life.

words.tr: phrase. 带路；示范；打先锋
words.ex: He will lead the way to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他将带路去公园。
words.en: To go first in order to show others how to follow; to be a pioneer or innovator in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 把…带到；导致；通向
words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 导致；引起；使话题（渐渐）转向
words.ex: The warm-up exercises lead up to the main workout.
words.ex_cn: 热身运动为主要内容的锻炼做准备。
words.en: To precede and help to cause or prepare for something.

words.tr: phrase. 了解；学习；获悉
words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 听说…；获悉；得知
words.ex: I just learned of the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚得知明天的会议。
words.en: To become aware of something, typically by being told about it.

words.tr: phrase. 熟记；背诵；牢记
words.ex: The students learn the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们把这首诗背熟了。
words.en: To memorize something thoroughly so that it can be recited or written without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 向...学习
words.ex: We should learn from our mistakes and not repeat them.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该从错误中学习，不再重蹈覆辙。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr: phrase. 最不；尤其不；特别是……也不（用于强调某人或某事最不应被提及或发生）
words.ex: She likes everyone in the class, but least of all the new student.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢班上的每个人，但最不喜欢新来的学生。
words.en: Used to emphasize that a particular person or thing is the one that is least likely to be affected by something or to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 留个话；留个口信
words.ex: Please leave a message if he is not available.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不在，请留个话。
words.en: If you leave a message, you leave a piece of information for someone, especially when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: phrase. 不打扰；不干涉；让…独自待着
words.ex: Please leave me alone when I am studying.
words.ex_cn: 当我学习时，请不要打扰我。
words.en: To allow someone or something to remain undisturbed or not to interfere with them.

words.tr: 撇开; 搁置，不考虑; 按
words.ex: Leave aside the noise and focus on your work.
words.ex_cn: 把噪音放在一边，专心工作。
words.en: To decide not to discuss or consider something in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 留下；忘带；抛弃
words.ex: He left behind his book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书留在了桌子上。
words.en: To go away from a place without taking someone or something with you.

words.tr: phrase. 到…去；出发前往
words.ex: He leaves for work at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点出发去上班。
words.en: To depart from a place to go to another.

words.tr: phrase. v. 停止；中断；不再穿（衣服）
words.ex: It's time to leave off talking and start working.
words.ex_cn: 是时候停止谈话开始工作了。
words.en: To stop doing something, especially something that you have been doing for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 离校；毕业；放学回家
words.ex: He decided to leave school and start working.
words.ex_cn: 他决定离开学校，开始工作。
words.en: to stop attending school or to graduate from school

words.tr: phrase. 把某物借给某人
words.ex: Can you lend your book to me?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的书借给我吗？
words.en: To give something to someone for a temporary period, expecting to get it back.

words.tr: phrase. 少于；不超过
words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.tr: phrase. 更不用说；何况
words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 放手；松开；释放；放弃
words.ex: He decided to let go of the old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他决定放开那个旧玩具。
words.en: To release one's hold on something or someone; to allow someone or something to leave or be free.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；允许...进入
words.ex: Please let in the cat when it starts to rain.
words.ex_cn: 当下雨时，请让猫进来。
words.en: To allow someone or something to enter a place.

words.tr: phrase. 放出；饶恕；准许...暂停工作
words.ex: He let off a loud whistle to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声吹口哨以引起注意。
words.en: To allow someone to escape punishment, or to release something such as steam or a bomb.

words.tr: phrase. 发出；放走；泄露
words.ex: He let out a loud scream.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊了一声。
words.en: To allow something to escape or be released; to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret; to rent out property.

words.tr: phrase. 减弱；停止；放松；暂停
words.ex: The rain finally let up after three days.
words.ex_cn: 三天后雨终于停了。
words.en: If something such as rain or noise lets up, it stops or becomes less intense.

words.tr: phrase. 躺下；接受；忍受；逃避（职责）
words.ex: He lies down after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后躺下。
words.en: To recline or rest in a horizontal position.

words.tr: phrase. 睡懒觉；在于；位于
words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.tr: phrase. 取决于；在于；由…决定
words.ex: The responsibility lies with the manager.
words.ex_cn: 责任在于经理。
words.en: If a decision or responsibility lies with someone, it is their responsibility to make the decision or deal with the matter.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；抬起；鼓舞；使振奋
words.ex: He lift up the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手把箱子举起来。
words.en: to raise something or someone to a higher position or level

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.tr: phrase. 连接；联合；汇合；与…取得联系
words.ex: The two towns will link up with a new road.
words.ex_cn: 这两个城镇将通过一条新路连接起来。
words.en: To connect or join together, especially in order to operate or function together.

words.tr: phrase. 与…连接；与…汇合；与…取得联系
words.ex: The two companies decided to link up with each other to increase their market share.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司决定相互衔接，以增加市场份额。
words.en: To connect or join with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 听
words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To pay attention to someone or something in order to hear what is being said, sung, played, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐地；一点一点地；慢慢地
words.ex: He learned to swim little by little.
words.ex_cn: 他一点一点地学会了游泳。
words.en: Gradually; in small stages or increments.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为生
words.ex: He lives by fishing in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在海里捕鱼为生。
words.en: To follow a particular principle or way of life, or to earn a living in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 住进；住在
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。
words.en: To reside or exist within a particular place or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.tr: phrase. 经历…而幸存；度过（艰难时期）；经受住
words.ex: He lived through a big storm last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一场大风暴。
words.en: To experience and survive a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.tr: phrase. 不辜负；做到；实践（诺言等）
words.ex: He tried hard to live up to his father's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力不辜负父亲的期望。
words.en: To perform as well as or achieve what is expected or promised.

words.tr: phrase. 把…锁起来；关进监狱；使（资金）冻结；关店
words.ex: He will lock up the shop at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上会把商店锁上。
words.en: To secure something by locking it, or to confine someone in a place by locking it.

words.tr: phrase. 登录
words.ex: He logs in to his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录邮箱。
words.en: To enter a computer system or website by typing your username and password.

words.tr: phrase. 登录
words.ex: He logs on to his computer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录电脑。
words.en: To log on is to access a computer system or network by entering your username and password.

words.tr: phrase. 很久以后；在…之后很久
words.ex: We will meet long after the sun sets.
words.ex_cn: 我们会在太阳落山很久以后见面。
words.en: A considerable time after a particular event or time.

words.tr: phrase. 很久以前
words.ex: He left home long before the sun rose.
words.ex_cn: 太阳升起之前很久，他就离开了家。
words.en: At a time earlier than a specified event or period.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望；向往；期盼
words.ex: He longs for his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望他的家乡。
words.en: To have a strong wish or desire for something.

words.tr: phrase. 环顾四周；察看周围情况；四处寻找
words.ex: He looks about the room for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他在房间里四处寻找他的钥匙。
words.en: To turn one's eyes in different directions in order to see something or to search for something.

words.tr: phrase. 环顾四周；参观
words.ex: He looks around the room to find his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他环顾房间找他的钥匙。
words.en: To direct one's gaze in various directions; to explore or examine a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 四处寻找；环顾四周搜寻
words.ex: He looks about for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都四处寻找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search or seek for something in various places.

words.tr: phrase. 四处寻找；到处搜寻
words.ex: He looks around for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都四处寻找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something in various places.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；照顾
words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 向前看；为将来打算
words.ex: We need to look ahead and plan for the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要展望未来并为将来做计划。
words.en: To think about what will happen in the future and plan for it.

words.tr: phrase. 看起来好像；似乎；仿佛
words.ex: He looks as if he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来好像累了。
words.en: to seem or appear to be something

words.tr: phrase. 看
words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.tr: phrase. 转移视线；把目光移开；故意不看
words.ex: He looks away when he feels shy.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到害羞时，他会把目光移开。
words.en: To turn one's eyes away from something so as not to see it.

words.tr: phrase. 把目光从…移开；避开…的视线
words.ex: He had to look away from the gruesome scene.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把目光从这可怕的场景移开。
words.en: To deliberately turn one's gaze away from someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾；回想；追忆（过去的事情）
words.ex: I look back on my childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 我满怀幸福地回忆我的童年。
words.en: To think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾；回忆；回想（过去的事）
words.ex: She likes to look back upon her childhood with fondness.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢带着温情回忆她的童年。
words.en: To think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 蔑视；瞧不起
words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 蔑视；瞧不起
words.ex: Some people look down upon others who have less money.
words.ex_cn: 有些人瞧不起那些钱少的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找
words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 展望；期待
words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便看望；顺道探视
words.ex: She decided to look in on her grandmother after work.
words.ex_cn: 她决定下班后去看看她的祖母。
words.en: To visit someone briefly, especially to see if they are all right or if they need anything.

words.tr: phrase. 看望
words.ex: I will look in on my grandma after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去看望我奶奶。
words.en: To make a brief visit or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 看起来像
words.ex: He looks like his father.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来像他的父亲。
words.en: To resemble or seem similar to someone or something in appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.tr: phrase. 把...看作；看待
words.ex: People look upon him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 人们把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看作…；把…视为…
words.ex: Many people look on him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 许多人把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看作…；把…视为…
words.ex: People look upon him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 人们把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 往外看；注意；留神
words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.tr: phrase. 当心；留心；寻找；照料
words.ex: Look out for the dog when you walk by.
words.ex_cn: 你经过时要当心那只狗。
words.en: To be vigilant or attentive; to watch for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 看起来一样；看上去相同
words.ex: They look the same, but they are not identical.
words.ex_cn: 他们看起来很象，但并不是完全相同。
words.en: To have an identical or very similar appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 浏览；逐一查看
words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 注意；指望；照看
words.ex: You must look to your health before it's too late.
words.ex_cn: 你必须注意你的健康，趁还来得及。
words.en: To expect or depend on someone or something to do something or provide something.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；查找；向上看
words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.tr: phrase. 上下打量；仔细审视；到处搜寻
words.ex: The man looked up and down the street before crossing.
words.ex_cn: 那人过马路前上下打量了街道。
words.en: To examine someone or something carefully from head to toe.

words.tr: phrase. 尊敬；仰慕；敬佩
words.ex: I look up to my teacher because she is kind and smart.
words.ex_cn: 我尊敬我的老师，因为她善良又聪明。
words.en: If you look up to someone, you respect and admire them.

words.tr: phrase. 失去对…的控制；无法掌控
words.ex: He loses control of his temper when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会控制不住自己的脾气。
words.en: If you lose control of something, you are no longer able to control it.

words.tr: phrase. 丢脸；失面子；出丑
words.ex: He didn't apologize because he didn't want to lose face.
words.ex_cn: 他没有道歉，因为他不想丢脸。
words.en: To lose face means to be humiliated or to lose the respect of others, often in a social context.

words.tr: phrase. 灰心；泄气；失去勇气
words.ex: Don't lose heart, you can try again.
words.ex_cn: 别灰心，你可以再试一次。
words.en: To become discouraged or disheartened.

words.tr: phrase. 对…失去兴趣；不再关心…
words.ex: He started to lose interest in his job after a few years.
words.ex_cn: 几年后，他对工作开始失去兴趣。
words.en: to stop being interested in something or someone

words.tr: phrase. 失去平衡；站不稳；失衡
words.ex: He loses his balance when the bus stops suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 当公交车突然停下时，他失去了平衡。
words.en: To lose one's balance means to become unsteady and fall or nearly fall.

words.tr: phrase. 失去理智；惊慌失措；慌乱
words.ex: Don't lose your head in an emergency.
words.ex_cn: 在紧急情况下不要惊慌失措。
words.en: To lose one's head means to become so upset or excited that one cannot think clearly or act sensibly.

words.tr: phrase. 对……关闭心扉；拒绝接受……的感情或影响
words.ex: Don't close your heart to new friends.
words.ex_cn: 不要对新朋友关闭心门。
words.en: To refuse to accept or be open to something, especially emotionally.

words.tr: phrase. 丧命
words.ex: He lost his life in the car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在车祸中丧生了。
words.en: To die, especially in a sudden or violent way.

words.tr: phrase. 失明；失去视力
words.ex: He lost his sight in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中失去了视力。
words.en: To become unable to see; to go blind.

words.tr: phrase. 发脾气；发怒
words.ex: He loses his temper when he hears loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他听到吵闹声时就会发脾气。
words.en: To lose one's temper means to suddenly become very angry.

words.tr: phrase. 失声；嗓子哑了
words.ex: He lost his voice after shouting at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上大喊后失去了声音。
words.en: To be unable to speak or to have one's voice become hoarse or inaudible, typically as a result of shouting, illness, or overuse of the vocal cords.

words.tr: phrase. 迷路；迷失
words.ex: He lost his way in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里迷路了。
words.en: to become unable to find one's way

words.tr: phrase. 结束；结清；处理掉；清仓
words.ex: They close out the store at 9 PM every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上9点关门。
words.en: To end or liquidate something, especially a business operation or a financial position.

words.tr: phrase. 看不见；忽视；忘记
words.ex: He drove so fast that he lost sight of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他开得太快，看不见路了。
words.en: If you lose sight of something, you forget about it or stop thinking about it because you are focusing on other things.

words.tr: phrase. 与…失去联系
words.ex: He lost touch with his old friends after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到一个新城市后，和老朋友失去了联系。
words.en: To no longer communicate with someone or be informed about something.

words.tr: phrase. 体重减轻；减肥
words.ex: He wants to lose weight by eating less and walking more.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过少吃多走来减肥。
words.en: To reduce one's body weight intentionally.

words.tr: phrase. 许多
words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 主修；专攻
words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 做出选择；作出抉择
words.ex: He must make a choice today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天必须做出选择。
words.en: To decide between two or more possibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 做决定；下决心
words.ex: He makes a decision quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做出决定。
words.en: To choose between options after consideration; to make up one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.tr: phrase. 做鬼脸；扮怪相
words.ex: He made a face when he tasted the sour lemon.
words.ex_cn: 他尝到酸柠檬时皱起了脸。
words.en: To make a facial expression, often to show emotion or amusement.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生
words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生；维持生计
words.ex: He makes his living by selling vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在市场卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn the money one needs to live.

words.tr: phrase. 作出承诺；许诺
words.ex: He make a promise to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit oneself to a future action or outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 发表演讲；做演讲
words.ex: He will make a speech at the school meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他将在学校会议上发表演讲。
words.en: To deliver a formal address or discourse to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 与…取得联系；与…接触；与…建立联系
words.ex: He tried to make contact with his friend by phone.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过电话与朋友取得联系。
words.en: To establish communication or connection with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；尽力；作出努力
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially when it requires a significant amount of work or determination.

words.tr: phrase. 走向；促进；有助于
words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 交朋友；建立友谊；与人结交
words.ex: He wants to make friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在学校交朋友。
words.en: To establish a relationship of mutual affection with someone, typically one that is not a romantic or family relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交朋友
words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 取笑
words.ex: They make fun of him for wearing old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他穿旧鞋子而取笑他。
words.en: To tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a way that is either playful or mocking.

words.tr: phrase. 及时到达；达到预定目标
words.ex: We need to leave now to make it to the train on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在必须出发，才能及时赶到火车。
words.en: To succeed in arriving at a place or achieving a goal.

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 发财；致富；发迹；取得成功
words.ex: He went to the city to make his fortune.
words.ex_cn: 他去城里发财了。
words.en: To become very rich or successful, especially by one's own efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；朝…走去；费力地走到
words.ex: He makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: To go or travel towards a particular place or in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 朝…方向前进；向…走去；努力前往
words.ex: He make one's way toward the door slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢向门口走去。
words.en: To move or proceed in the direction of something.

words.tr: phrase. 穿过；费力地通过；设法完成；在…中前进
words.ex: He is making his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他正在穿过人群。
words.en: To move through a place or a group of people, especially when it is difficult or crowded.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 取得进步；取得进展
words.ex: He is making progress in his English speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语口语方面正在取得进步。
words.en: To advance or develop towards a better, more complete, or more modern state.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用；尽力而为；在不利条件下尽量做好
words.ex: He made the best of his small room by adding shelves.
words.ex_cn: 他通过加装架子，充分利用了自己狭小的房间。
words.en: To use or deal with something in a way that gets the most positive results from it, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 最大限度地利用
words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 使用
words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 设法做成某事；成功完成某事
words.ex: He manages to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能设法完成作业。
words.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something that requires effort or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的；成堆的
words.ex: There are masses of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上有大量的人。
words.en: A large quantity or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做某事；有意做某事；故意做某事
words.ex: I didn't mean to hurt you.
words.ex_cn: 我并不是有意要伤害你。
words.en: If you mean to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看错成；把…误解成
words.ex: He often mistakes the cat for the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他经常把猫错认成狗。
words.en: To confuse someone or something with another person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 混合；混淆
words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.tr: phrase. 越来越多
words.ex: More and more people use phones to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 越来越多的人用手机学英语。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is increasing in quantity or degree over time.

words.tr: phrase. 或多或少
words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 超过；多于
words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.tr: phrase. 太……；过于……；实在太
words.ex: The task is much too difficult for a beginner.
words.ex_cn: 这项任务对于初学者来说太难了。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; excessively.

words.tr: phrase. 按...命名
words.ex: The park was named after a famous hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是以一位著名英雄的名字命名的。
words.en: If you name someone or something after another person or thing, you give them the same name as that person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 九死一生；险些遇难；侥幸逃脱
words.ex: He had a narrow escape when the car skidded off the road.
words.ex_cn: 他的车滑出路面，真是九死一生。
words.en: A situation in which someone only just avoids danger or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 不必说
words.ex: Needless to say, he was late again.
words.ex_cn: 不用说，他又迟到了。
words.en: used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 既不…也不…
words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: used to introduce two or more negative possibilities, indicating that none of them is true or will happen

words.tr: phrase. 没关系；不用担心
words.ex: Never mind the mistake, let's keep going.
words.ex_cn: 别管那个错误了，我们继续吧。
words.en: You say 'never mind' when you are emphasizing that something is not serious or important, especially when someone is upset about it or you are telling them not to worry about it.

words.tr: phrase. 紧邻；在…近旁
words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr: phrase. 不再
words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 没问题；不用谢；没关系
words.ex: No problem, I will help you.
words.ex_cn: 没问题，我会帮你。
words.en: Used to express that something is easy, acceptable, or not an issue.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr: phrase. 想起；想到
words.ex: It did not occur to him to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他没想到要打电话求助。
words.en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, it comes into your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 有史以来；空前；历来
words.ex: He is the best player of all time.
words.ex_cn: 他是有史以来最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize that someone or something is the best or most important of their kind in history.

words.tr: phrase. 当然
words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 属于自己的；自己专有的
words.ex: Every child should have a room of his own.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应该有自己的房间。
words.en: belonging to oneself and no one else

words.tr: phrase. 当前的；此刻最重要的；风头正劲的
words.ex: This trend is of the moment, but it may not last long.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势是当下的热点，但可能不会持续很久。
words.en: If you refer to someone or something as the person or thing of the moment, you mean that they are very popular or fashionable at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 下班的；不值班的；下了班的
words.ex: He is off duty today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天休息。
words.en: If someone is off duty, they are not working.

words.tr: phrase. 由于
words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.tr: phrase. 匍匐着；四肢着地；趴着
words.ex: The baby crawled on all fours.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿爬行时四肢着地。
words.en: Moving or supporting the body with both hands and both feet on the ground.

words.tr: phrase. 不停地；持续不断地；没完没了地
words.ex: The rain went on and on all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨整晚不停地下。
words.en: Continuing without stopping or pausing.

words.tr: phrase. 平均
words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；作为代言人
words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: phrase. 在船（车或飞机）上
words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 出差；业务方面
words.ex: He is traveling on business.
words.ex_cn: 他出差。
words.en: If someone is on business, they are away from their usual place of work because they are doing something connected with their job.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为条件；若是…
words.ex: You can go out on condition that you come home before 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 你可以出去，条件是你必须在晚上10点前回家。
words.en: used to say that one thing will happen only if another thing happens

words.tr: phrase. 一接触就…；在接触时
words.ex: He feels pain on contact with the wound.
words.ex_cn: 他一碰到伤口就感到疼痛。
words.en: At the moment of touching or meeting something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 一接触到…；与…接触时
words.ex: The alarm goes off on contact with the intruder.
words.ex_cn: 警报器一接触到入侵者就会响起。
words.en: At the moment of touching or meeting something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 值班的；当值的；值勤的；在上班
words.ex: The nurse is on duty tonight.
words.ex_cn: 护士今晚在值班。
words.en: If someone is on duty, they are working at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 在世上；究竟
words.ex: What on earth are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 你到底在干什么？
words.en: Used for emphasis in questions to express surprise or confusion.

words.tr: phrase. 连续地；不断地；竖着地；直立着
words.ex: He watched TV on end.
words.ex_cn: 他连续看电视。
words.en: If something happens for hours, days, weeks, or years on end, it happens continuously and without stopping for that amount of time.

words.tr: phrase. 着火；非常激动
words.ex: The building was on fire, and people were trying to escape.
words.ex_cn: 大楼着火了，人们正在试图逃离。
words.en: If something is on fire, it is burning and being damaged or destroyed by flames.

words.tr: phrase. 步行；走路
words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.tr: phrase. 与…关系良好；与…相处融洽
words.ex: She is on good terms with her neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 她与邻居关系良好。
words.en: Having a friendly relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 警惕的；提防的；站岗的；戒备着的
words.ex: The soldier is on guard at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在门口站岗。
words.en: Being on guard means being watchful and alert to danger or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 在手头；临近
words.ex: We have enough food on hand for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们手头有足够的食物用于聚会。
words.en: Available or present; ready for use.

words.tr: phrase. 度假；休假
words.ex: They are on holiday in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在西班牙度假。
words.en: If you are on holiday, you are spending a period of time away from work or school, usually in order to relax or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 有时；间或
words.ex: He visits his grandparents on occasion.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Sometimes but not often.

words.tr: phrase. 供应的；可获得的；特价出售的；正在出售的
words.ex: There are many discounts on offer this week.
words.ex_cn: 本周有很多折扣优惠。
words.en: If something is on offer, it is available for sale or is being provided.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；独立地
words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.tr: phrase. 就某人而言；在某人方面；由某人所做的
words.ex: The failure was not due to lack of effort on my part.
words.ex_cn: 这次失败并不是因为我这边没有努力。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is done or caused by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的路上
words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: In the process of going or traveling to a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 在路上；在途中
words.ex: The pizza is on the way.
words.ex_cn: 披萨正在路上。
words.en: If something or someone is on the way, they are about to arrive or they are in the process of coming or going.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人去…的路上
words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: If you are on your way to a place, you are traveling towards it and have not yet arrived.

words.tr: phrase. 在去...的途中
words.ex: He is on the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: In the process of going somewhere or becoming something.

words.tr: phrase. 出于原则；根据原则；按信条行事
words.ex: He refused to lie on principle.
words.ex_cn: 他出于原则拒绝撒谎。
words.en: If you do something on principle, you do it because of a particular belief that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 故意； 有意
words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.tr: phrase. 出售；廉价出售
words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周鞋子在出售。
words.en: If products in a shop are on sale, they can be bought for less than their normal price.

words.tr: phrase. 转念一想；经过重新考虑后
words.ex: I will go to the party. On second thought, I will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 我打算去派对。再想想，我还是待在家里吧。
words.en: After reconsidering; used to indicate a change of mind or opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 进一步考虑后
words.ex: I will go to the party. On second thoughts, I will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 我会去参加派对。再想想，我还是待在家里吧。
words.en: After reconsidering something; used to introduce a statement that is different from what you said before.

words.tr: phrase. 展出的；陈列着的；公开展示的
words.ex: The paintings are on show at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画正在博物馆展出。
words.en: If something is on show, it is being exhibited or displayed for people to see.

words.tr: phrase. 一见到就…；立即；当场
words.ex: He recognized her on sight.
words.ex_cn: 他一看到她就认出了她。
words.en: If something happens on sight, it happens immediately when someone or something is seen.

words.tr: phrase. 警惕；注意
words.ex: The guard was on the alert for any strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 警卫对任何奇怪的动静都保持警惕。
words.en: If you are on the alert for something, you are ready to deal with it if it happens.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
