words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 濒于；即将要
words.ex: He is on the brink of quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正处在辞职的边缘。
words.en: If you are on the brink of something, you are very close to experiencing it or doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 与此相反；正相反
words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在衰退中；在下降；在走下坡路
words.ex: The number of students is on the decline.
words.ex_cn: 学生人数正在减少。
words.en: If something is on the decline, it is gradually decreasing in importance, quality, or power.

words.tr: phrase. 在增长；不断增加；呈上升趋势
words.ex: The number of cars on the road is on the increase.
words.ex_cn: 道路上的汽车数量正在增加。
words.en: If something is on the increase, it is happening more often or becoming greater in number or intensity.

words.w: on the one hand ... on the other ...
words.tr: phrase. 一方面……另一方面……（用于对比或平衡两个不同的观点或情况）
words.uk: ɒn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɒn ðə ˈʌðə...
words.us: ɑːn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɑːn ðə ˈʌðɚ...
words.ex: On the one hand, he wants to travel. On the other, he needs to work.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，他想去旅行。另一方面，他又需要工作。
words.en: Used to introduce two contrasting points of view, facts, or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 一方面……另一方面……；用于对比或权衡两个相反或不同的观点
words.uk: ɒn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɒn ði ˈʌðə hænd ...
words.us: ɑːn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɑːn ði ˈʌðər hænd ...
words.ex: On the one hand, he wants to travel. On the other hand, he needs to save money.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，他想旅行。另一方面，他需要省钱。
words.en: Used to present two contrasting points of view or facts about something.

words.tr: phrase. 用电话交谈；在通话
words.ex: He is talking on the phone with his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和妈妈打电话。
words.en: Using the telephone to communicate with someone.

words.w: on the point of doing sth.
words.tr: phrase. 正要做某事；即将做某事；马上就要做某事
words.uk: ɒn ðə pɔɪnt əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɑːn ðə pɔɪnt əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He is on the point of leaving when the phone rings.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开，这时电话响了。
words.en: If you are on the point of doing something, you are about to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 在广播中；通过无线电；在收音机里
words.ex: The song is on the radio now.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌现在在广播里播放。
words.en: Being broadcast or able to be heard on the radio.

words.tr: 通过无线电广播：指通过无线电广播传输信息或进行通信。
words.ex: He heard the news over the radio.
words.ex_cn: 他通过收音机听到了这个新闻。
words.en: Through the medium of radio broadcasting.

words.tr: phrase. 在上涨；增长
words.ex: The cost of food is on the rise.
words.ex_cn: 食品价格正在上涨。
words.en: Increasing in number, amount, or intensity.

words.tr: phrase. 在逃；匆忙地；奔波；不停地移动
words.ex: He has been on the run since the bank heist.
words.ex_cn: 自从银行抢劫案以来，他一直在逃亡。
words.en: If someone is on the run, they are trying to avoid being captured by the police, often by moving from place to place.

words.tr: phrase. 当场；在现场
words.ex: He answered the question on the spot.
words.ex_cn: 他当场回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something on the spot, you do it immediately without any delay.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在舞台上；当演员；从事表演工作
words.ex: He is dancing on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 他正在舞台上跳舞。
words.en: On the stage refers to being in the area of a theatre where actors perform.

words.w: on the tip of one's tongue
words.tr: phrase. 话到嘴边却想不起来；几乎要想起（却说不出来）
words.uk: ɒn ðə tɪp əv wʌnz tʌŋ
words.us: ɑːn ðə tɪp əv wʌnz tʌŋ
words.ex: The answer was on the tip of his tongue, but he couldn't say it.
words.ex_cn: 答案就在他嘴边，但他就是说不出来。
words.en: If a word or piece of information is on the tip of your tongue, you are sure that you know it and that you will be able to remember it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 正在离开；即将过时；快要被淘汰
words.ex: The old phone is on the way out.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机正在被淘汰。
words.en: Becoming less popular or common; about to leave or disappear.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 按时；准时
words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.tr: phrase. 再一次
words.ex: He forgot his keys once again.
words.ex_cn: 他又一次忘了带钥匙。
words.en: used to say that something happens again or is repeated

words.tr: phrase. 极为罕见地；千载难逢地
words.ex: He visits his hometown once in a blue moon.
words.ex_cn: 他很少回老家。
words.en: If you say that something happens once in a blue moon, you mean that it happens very rarely.

words.tr: phrase. 偶尔；有时；间或
words.ex: I eat ice cream once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 再一次
words.ex: He tried once more to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他再次尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: One more time; again.

words.tr: phrase. 从前；很久以前
words.ex: Once upon a time, a boy lived in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 从前，一个男孩住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: Used at the beginning of a story to indicate that it happened a long time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 逐个地；一个接一个地；依次地
words.ex: The children left the room one by one.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: Individually and in succession; one after another.

words.tr: phrase. 有一天；总有一天
words.ex: One day, he will become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 总有一天，他会成为一名医生。
words.en: At some time in the future, especially when it is not known exactly when.

words.tr: phrase. 只有…才；除非
words.ex: You can enter the room only if you have a pass.
words.ex_cn: 只有当你有通行证时，你才能进入房间。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen or be true just in one particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 结果却…；不料竟…（表示出乎意料的结果）
words.ex: He woke up early only to find the door locked.
words.ex_cn: 他早早醒来，结果发现门锁着。
words.en: Used to indicate an unexpected or disappointing result.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…动手术；对…起作用；在…上操作
words.ex: The doctor will operate on the patient tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天将为病人做手术。
words.en: To perform a surgical procedure on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 否则
words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.tr: phrase. 更确切地说；倒不如说
words.ex: He is not lazy, or rather, he is efficient in his own way.
words.ex_cn: 他并不懒，或者更准确地说，他有自己的高效方式。
words.en: used to correct or modify what has just been said, or to say it more accurately

words.tr: phrase. 大约
words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: phrase. 应该
words.ex: You ought to drink more water.
words.ex_cn: 你应该多喝水。
words.en: Used to indicate duty or correctness, typically when criticizing someone's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 喘不过气来的；上气不接下气的
words.ex: He ran fast and was out of breath.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，气喘吁吁。
words.en: If you are out of breath, you are breathing very quickly and with difficulty, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.tr: phrase. 失控的；无法控制的；失去控制的
words.ex: The car was out of control on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的路面上失去了控制。
words.en: If something is out of control, no one has any power over it.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的；废弃的
words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.tr: phrase. 出故障的；次序颠倒的；不合规定的；不适的
words.ex: The elevator is out of order.
words.ex_cn: 电梯坏了。
words.en: If something is out of order, it is not working properly.

words.tr: phrase. 不在适当的位置；不合适的；格格不入的
words.ex: His shirt was out of place at the formal party.
words.ex_cn: 他在正式晚会上穿的衬衫很不合适。
words.en: If someone or something is out of place, they are in a situation where they do not belong or fit in.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 出于尊敬；出于对…的尊重
words.ex: He stood up out of respect for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他为了尊重老师而站起来。
words.en: Out of respect refers to doing something because you respect someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 看不见；在视野以外
words.ex: The keys are out of sight under the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在沙发下面，看不见了。
words.en: If something is out of sight, it is too far away to be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 不可能
words.ex: It is out of the question to buy a new car now.
words.ex_cn: 现在买一辆新车是绝对不可能的。
words.en: If you say that something is out of the question, you are emphasizing that it is completely impossible or unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex: He is out of work after the factory closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他失业了。
words.en: If someone is out of work, they do not have a job.

words.tr: phrase. 反复地；一遍又一遍地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: If you say that something happens over and over or over and over again, you are emphasizing that it happens many times.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；反复地；不断地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over again.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.tr: v. 归功于；欠；
words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因...之缘故
words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；参加
words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 去世；逝世；消亡
words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.tr: phrase. 经过
words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 往下传；遗传；传承
words.ex: My grandfather passed down his old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父把他的旧手表传给了我。
words.en: To transmit or hand down from one generation to another.

words.tr: phrase. 传递
words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it or using it; to continue moving forward; to die.

words.tr: phrase. 昏倒；失去知觉；（军队中）分发；散发
words.ex: He felt dizzy and started to pass out.
words.ex_cn: 他感到头晕，开始昏倒。
words.en: If someone passes out, they become unconscious for a short time, often because they are tired, ill, or have drunk too much alcohol. It can also mean to distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；通过；经历；经历并完成
words.ex: We pass through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: To move or travel through a place or area.

words.tr: phrase. 放弃；拒绝
words.ex: Don't pass up this opportunity; it may never come again.
words.ex_cn: 不要错过这个机会；它可能再也不会来了。
words.en: To choose not to take advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 去参观；拜访；访问
words.ex: We will pay a visit to the museum tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天要去参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to see someone or something, especially for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 注意； 留意
words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.tr: phrase. 偿还；还钱；报复；回报
words.ex: He will pay back the money tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会还钱。
words.en: To pay back means to return money that you have borrowed or to take revenge on someone.

words.tr: phrase. 付账；付出代价
words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 付清；偿还（欠款）；缴清（应付款项）
words.ex: He must pay up before he leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前必须付钱。
words.en: To pay a debt or an amount owed in full.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；固执于
words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 说服某人做某事
words.ex: He persuaded her to go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他劝她去参加聚会。
words.en: To cause someone to do something by giving them good reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 挑出；辨别出
words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 堆积；积累
words.ex: Books are piling up on the table.
words.ex_cn: 书正堆在桌子上。
words.en: If things pile up, they gradually increase in number or amount until there is a large quantity of them.

words.tr: phrase. 捉弄；开玩笑
words.ex: He played a joke on his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跟朋友开了个玩笑。
words.en: To play a joke on someone means to trick them in a humorous way.

words.tr: phrase. 开…的玩笑；捉弄；对…搞恶作剧
words.ex: He likes to play jokes on his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢捉弄他的弟弟。
words.en: To play jokes on someone means to trick them or make them the subject of a joke, often in a playful manner.

words.tr: phrase. 扮演一个角色；参与；在……中起作用
words.ex: He plays a part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的戏剧中扮演一个角色。
words.en: To have a role or influence in something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...扮演一个角色；起作用
words.ex: Exercise plays a role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起作用。
words.en: To have a part or influence in something.

words.tr: phrase. 与...一起玩
words.ex: The children play with toys in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩玩具。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 许多
words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.tr: phrase. 指向
words.ex: The child points at the dog and laughs.
words.ex_cn: 那孩子指着狗笑。
words.en: To direct someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or a similar object in its direction.

words.tr: phrase. 润色；改进；使更完善；擦亮
words.ex: He will polish up his English before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他将在旅行前把英语提高一下。
words.en: To improve or refine something, especially a skill or piece of work, by making small changes.

words.tr: phrase. 大量涌入；源源而来；不断注入
words.ex: People pour in to see the new movie on opening day.
words.ex_cn: 人们在首映日涌入观看新电影。
words.en: If people pour in or pour into a place, they come or go there in large numbers.

words.tr: phrase. 倒出；倾泻；倾诉；涌出
words.ex: He poured out the water from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子里的水倒了出来。
words.en: To pour out means to cause a liquid or other substance to flow out of a container, or to express your feelings or thoughts freely.

words.tr: phrase. 更喜欢做某事；宁愿做某事
words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: If you prefer to do something, you like that thing better than another thing and would choose it if you could.

words.w: prefer to do rather than do
words.tr: phrase. 宁愿做……而不愿做……；比起后者更喜欢前者
words.uk: prɪˈfɜː(r) tə duː ˈrɑːðə ðæn duː
words.us: prɪˈfɜːr tə duː ˈræðər ðæn duː
words.ex: I prefer to walk rather than drive.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿走路也不愿开车。
words.en: To choose one thing or action over another.

words.tr: phrase. 为…作准备
words.ex: He prepares for the test every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试做准备。
words.en: To make ready or get set for a future event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止某人做某事
words.ex: The fence prevents dogs from running into the street.
words.ex_cn: 围栏阻止狗跑上街道。
words.en: To stop someone from doing something or to stop something from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 保护...使不受...
words.ex: Wear a helmet to protect your head against injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴上头盔以保护头部免受伤害。
words.en: guard or defend something or someone from harm or danger

words.tr: v. 保护
words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应
words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: To make available for use; to supply.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人提供某物；把某物供给某人
words.ex: The teacher provides books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生提供书籍。
words.en: To give something to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 拆毁（建筑物）；拉下；降低（价格、水平等）
words.ex: They pull down the old house to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们拆掉旧房子来建一所新学校。
words.en: To pull down something means to destroy it or remove it from its position.

words.tr: phrase. 进站；靠岸；赚取
words.ex: The bus pulls in at the station every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟进站一次。
words.en: To attract or earn money; to arrest someone; (of a vehicle) to move into a particular place or to stop at a station.

words.tr: phrase. 成功完成（困难的事）；脱下；扯掉；把车驶离（道路）
words.ex: She managed to pull off a surprise party for her husband.
words.ex_cn: 她成功地为丈夫举办了一个惊喜派对。
words.en: To succeed in doing something difficult or tricky.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. （把车）靠边停下；靠边停车
words.ex: The police told him to pull over.
words.ex_cn: 警察让他靠边停车。
words.en: To move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop, especially when instructed by the police.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使恢复健康；使苏醒；使好转
words.ex: The doctor said he will pull round after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生说他手术后会恢复的。
words.en: To recover from illness or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 渡过难关；恢复健康；使脱离险境
words.ex: With the support of his family, he managed to pull through the difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 在家人的支持下，他成功渡过了难关。
words.en: To survive a difficult or dangerous situation; to recover from an illness.

words.tr: phrase. 拔起；停下；提高
words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.tr: phrase. 推进；继续推行；坚决执行（计划、项目等）
words.ex: The government will push ahead with the new education plan.
words.ex_cn: 政府将推进新的教育计划。
words.en: To continue with a plan or activity, especially in a determined way.

words.tr: phrase. 努力争取；强烈要求；奋力推进
words.ex: They will push for a better deal.
words.ex_cn: 他们将争取更好的交易。
words.en: To make a determined effort to achieve or obtain something, often in the face of opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；坚持下去；继续推进
words.ex: He pushes on despite the pain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管疼痛，他仍然继续前进。
words.en: To continue moving forward or to proceed with something, especially in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 继续进行；坚持做；加紧推进（某事）
words.ex: He pushes on with his homework even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使很累，他还是继续做作业。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially when it is difficult or you are tired.

words.tr: phrase. 挤过；奋力穿过；推开人群前行
words.ex: He pushed his way through the crowd to get to the front.
words.ex_cn: 他推开人群挤到前面。
words.en: To move forward with difficulty through a crowd or a tight space by pushing people or things out of the way.

words.tr: phrase. 易被说服的人；易被打败的人；软柿子
words.ex: He tried to push over the box, but it was too heavy.
words.ex_cn: 他想把箱子推倒，但它太重了。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse by applying force.

words.tr: phrase. 使被理解；把…讲清楚；成功地表达（想法、观点等）
words.ex: He tried to put across his idea clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他试图清楚地表达他的想法。
words.en: To communicate something clearly and effectively to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；终止
words.ex: The new law will put an end to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将结束污染。
words.en: To cause something to stop or to finish something.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 放回；推迟；延误
words.ex: Please put back the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 请把书放回书架上。
words.en: To return something to its original place or to postpone an event or action.

words.tr: phrase. v. 储蓄；储存备用；把…放在一边；暂时搁置
words.ex: He puts by a little money every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都存一点钱。
words.en: To save or store something, especially money, for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.tr: phrase. 提出（观点、理论等）；伸出；发挥；使长出（芽、叶等）
words.ex: He put forth a new idea at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To present or propose something for consideration; to exert or extend.

words.tr: phrase. 提出
words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 把……关进监狱；使……入狱
words.ex: The judge will put the thief in prison.
words.ex_cn: 法官将把小偷关进监狱。
words.en: To confine someone in a prison as a punishment for a crime.

words.tr: phrase. 把…放进…；把…投入…；把…翻译成…；使处于…状态
words.ex: He puts his books into his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进书包里。
words.en: To place something inside something else.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事付诸行动；实施某事；把…付诸实践
words.ex: He put his plan into action last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周把计划付诸实施。
words.en: To start doing something that has been planned or discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；执行某事
words.ex: The new rule will put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一生效。
words.en: To implement or bring something into operation.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事付诸实践；实施；实行
words.ex: He put his ideas into practice.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的想法付诸实践。
words.en: To apply a plan, idea, or method in a real situation.

words.tr: phrase. 延期；推迟
words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 确切指出（问题、原因等）；准确识别
words.ex: I can't put my finger on the problem, but something feels wrong.
words.ex_cn: 我无法指出问题所在，但感觉有些不对劲。
words.en: To identify or describe something exactly.

words.w: put one's foot in one's mouth
words.tr: phrase. （因说错话而）使人尴尬；说错话；祸从口出
words.uk: pʊt wʌnz fʊt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.us: pʊt wʌnz fʊt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.ex: He put his foot in his mouth when he called his teacher 'mom'.
words.ex_cn: 他把老师叫成“妈妈”时，说错了话。
words.en: To say something that is embarrassing, wrong, or foolish, especially in a social situation.

words.w: put one's hand in one's pocket
words.tr: phrase. 掏腰包；出钱；慷慨解囊
words.uk: pʊt wʌnz hænd ɪn wʌnz ˈpɒkɪt
words.us: pʊt wʌnz hænd ɪn wʌnz ˈpɑːkɪt
words.ex: He put his hand in his pocket and gave money to the poor man.
words.ex_cn: 他把手伸进口袋，给了那个穷人一些钱。
words.en: To spend money or to be willing to spend money, especially in order to help someone or to pay for something.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…施加压力；逼迫；迫使
words.ex: They put pressure on him to finish the work quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他们给他施加压力，让他尽快完成工作。
words.en: To apply force or influence to someone or something in order to make them do something or to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: phrase. 对…施加压力；迫使
words.ex: They put pressure upon him to accept the job.
words.ex_cn: 他们施加压力让他接受这份工作。
words.en: To apply force or influence on someone or something to achieve a desired outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 使经受；接通（电话）
words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.tr: phrase. 组成整体；装配；组合
words.ex: He put together a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他做了个三明治当午餐。
words.en: To assemble or compile various parts or elements into a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.tr: phrase. 忍受；容忍
words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 对…苦思冥想；为…绞尽脑汁；反复琢磨
words.ex: He puzzles over the math problem for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他花了好几个小时思考那道数学题。
words.en: If you puzzle over something, you think hard about it because you find it difficult to understand or solve.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多……
words.ex: There are quantities of water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里有大量的水。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人就某事争吵；因某事与某人发生口角
words.ex: He quarreled with his brother about the TV remote.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟因为电视遥控器吵了起来。
words.en: To have an angry argument or disagreement with someone about something.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事与某人争吵；为某事跟某人吵架
words.ex: He quarreled with his brother over the last piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟因为最后一块蛋糕吵架了。
words.en: To argue or disagree with someone about something.

words.tr: phrase. 排队等候
words.ex: People queue up to buy bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 人们每天早上排队买面包。
words.en: To form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.tr: phrase. 相当多
words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 下倾盆大雨
words.ex: It is raining cats and dogs outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面下着倾盆大雨。
words.en: To rain very heavily.

words.tr: phrase. 筹钱
words.ex: They are trying to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在努力为学校筹钱。
words.en: To collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or for a political campaign.

words.tr: phrase. 扬起眉毛（表示惊讶、怀疑、不满或轻蔑）
words.ex: He raises his eyebrows when he hears the surprising news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个令人惊讶的消息时，他扬起了眉毛。
words.en: To raise one's eyebrows means to move them upwards as a sign of surprise, doubt, or disapproval.

words.tr: phrase. 在…到…的范围间变动
words.ex: The prices range from $5 to $20.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到20美元不等。
words.en: If things range from one thing to another, they vary within these limits on a scale of measurement or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.tr: phrase. 有点儿太；稍微过于
words.ex: He is rather too tired to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，走不动了。
words.en: Used to indicate a preference or to express that something is somewhat more than desirable.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出
words.ex: He will reach out to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会联系他的朋友。
words.en: To reach out means to extend one's hand outward in order to touch or grasp something, or to make contact with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出去摸，抓或拿
words.ex: He will reach out to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会联系他的朋友。
words.en: To make an effort to communicate with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 反抗
words.ex: Teenagers often react against rules set by parents.
words.ex_cn: 青少年经常反抗父母设定的规矩。
words.en: To act in opposition to a force, influence, or movement.

words.tr: v. 反应
words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: phrase. 读出; 读出器，读出( readout的过去式和过去分词 ); 大声朗诵，宣读
words.ex: The teacher will read out the names of the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将会念出学生的名字。
words.en: To read something aloud so that others can hear it.

words.tr: phrase. 指望；依赖；期望
words.ex: I reckon on your help to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我指望你的帮助来完成这个项目。
words.en: If you reckon on something, you expect it to happen and include it in your plans.

words.tr: phrase. 承认...是...
words.ex: People recognize him as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 人们认为他是一位伟大的老师。
words.en: To acknowledge someone or something as having a particular status or identity.

words.tr: v. 推荐；建议；
words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: phrase. 恢复；复原
words.ex: He will recover from the flu next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会从流感中康复。
words.en: To recover from something means to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after experiencing an illness, injury, or emotional distress.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 把…称作；把…当作
words.ex: People often refer to the city as the 'Big Apple'.
words.ex_cn: 人们常把这座城市称作“大苹果”。
words.en: To call someone or something by a particular name or title.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细想；考虑；反思；带来不良影响
words.ex: He likes to reflect on his day before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前反思自己的一天。
words.en: If you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

words.tr: phrase. 拒绝做某事；不愿做某事
words.ex: He refuses to do something he thinks is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝做他认为错误的事情。
words.en: To decline or reject a request or action.

words.tr: phrase. 把…视为…；认为…是…；把…看作…
words.ex: Many people regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 许多人把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不顾
words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.tr: phrase. 后悔做了某事；对做过的事感到遗憾
words.ex: I regret telling her the secret.
words.ex_cn: 我后悔告诉了她那个秘密。
words.en: To feel sad, repentant, or disappointed over (something that has happened or been done, especially a loss or missed opportunity).

words.tr: phrase. 有关；涉及
words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 解除某人的（职务、负担等）；从某人手中拿走；使某人摆脱
words.ex: The new medicine can relieve him of his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药可以减轻他的疼痛。
words.en: To free someone from a burden, duty, or responsibility.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖；依靠
words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 评论；谈论；就…发表意见
words.ex: He did not remark on the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他没有对这个错误发表意见。
words.en: To make a comment or observation about something.

words.tr: phrase. 评论；谈论；就…发表意见
words.ex: He did not remark upon the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那个错误。
words.en: To mention or comment on something.

words.tr: phrase. 记得曾经做过某事（强调动作已发生）
words.ex: I remember locking the door before I left.
words.ex_cn: 我记得离开前锁了门。
words.en: To recall or bring to mind an action or event that one has experienced in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人想起某事；提醒某人某事
words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: If someone or something reminds you of another person or thing, they make you think of that person or thing because they are similar in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人去做某事
words.ex: My mom reminds me to do my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈提醒我做作业。
words.en: To cause someone to remember to do something.

words.w: remind sb. not to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人不要做某事
words.uk: rɪˈmaɪnd ˈsʌmbədi nɒt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: rɪˈmaɪnd ˈsʌmbɑdi nɑt tə du ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: Mom reminded me not to eat too much candy.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈提醒我不要吃太多糖果。
words.en: To cause someone to remember not to do something.

words.tr: v. 代替；取代；
words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr: v. 去掉；移开；消除；
words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 从…辞职；辞去（职务）；退出（组织、职位）
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: To formally announce that you are leaving a job, position, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 听任；甘心接受；使自己顺从于
words.ex: He resigns himself to the fact that change takes time.
words.ex_cn: 他只好接受改变需要时间这一事实。
words.en: To accept something unpleasant that one cannot do anything about.

words.tr: phrase. 回应
words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 导致
words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 从…退休；从…退役；退出（某项活动或职业）
words.ex: He will retire from work next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将从工作中退休。
words.en: To leave one's job and cease to work, typically upon reaching a certain age.

words.tr: phrase. 回到；返回到
words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 使摆脱；使去除；从…中清除
words.ex: We must rid the house of ants.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须把房子里的蚂蚁清除掉。
words.en: To rid someone or something of something unwanted means to free them from it.

words.tr: phrase. 取决于；依靠；继续骑乘；继续进行
words.ex: He rides on his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: To continue moving forward or to depend on something for success.

words.tr: phrase. 马上；立即
words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 现在；立刻
words.ex: He is eating lunch right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在吃午饭。
words.en: At this very moment; immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 回拨电话；给某人回电话
words.ex: He will ring back after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会回电话。
words.en: To call someone back, usually after they have called you and you were unable to answer at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断电话
words.ex: He rang off before I could say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 我还没来得及说再见，他就挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by putting the receiver down.

words.tr: phrase. 突然响起；鸣响；发出清脆响亮的声音
words.ex: The bell will ring out at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟将在中午敲响。
words.en: To make a loud, clear sound, often used to describe sounds that are heard over a long distance or that stand out in a particular environment.

words.tr: phrase. v. 打电话；将（金额）记入收银机；记录销售额
words.ex: He will ring up his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会给朋友打电话。
words.en: To call someone on the telephone; to record a sale on a cash register.

words.tr: phrase. 撕掉；扯下；欺诈；敲竹杠 n. 欺诈行为；冒牌货
words.ex: He ripped off the old sticker from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子上的旧贴纸撕掉了。
words.en: To charge someone too much money for something, or to steal something from someone.

words.tr: phrase. 站起来；起身
words.ex: He rose to his feet when the teacher entered the room.
words.ex_cn: 老师进教室时，他站了起来。
words.en: To stand up, especially after sitting or kneeling.

words.tr: phrase. 奋起反抗；起来反对
words.ex: The citizens decided to rise up against the oppressive government.
words.ex_cn: 市民决定反抗压迫的政府。
words.en: To oppose or fight against a government, ruler, or system, often through violent means.

words.tr: phrase. 冒生命危险；拼命
words.ex: He risked his life to save the boy from the river.
words.ex_cn: 他冒着生命危险从河里救出了那个男孩。
words.en: To risk one's life means to do something that could result in one's death.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人某物；抢劫某人某物
words.ex: The thieves robbed him of his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 小偷抢走了他的钱包。
words.en: To take something away from someone by force; to deprive someone of something.

words.tr: phrase. 大量涌来
words.ex: He rolls in late every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都迟到。
words.en: To arrive or appear in large quantities or amounts.

words.tr: phrase. 翻身；打滚
words.ex: The baby learned to roll over at three months.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝三个月大时学会了翻身。
words.en: To move by turning over and over on an axis; to defer or transfer something to a later time or another account.

words.tr: phrase. 卷起；到达；出现；渐次增加
words.ex: He roll up his sleeves before starting work.
words.ex_cn: 他开始工作前卷起了袖子。
words.en: To roll up means to form something into a cylindrical or spherical shape by winding or folding, or to arrive somewhere, often unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 使聚合起来；围捕
words.ex: The farmer will round up the cows in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 农夫将在晚上把牛群赶拢。
words.en: To gather or collect people or things into a group, especially by using force; to increase a number to the nearest whole number.

words.tr: phrase. 划去；排除
words.ex: He ruled out the wrong answer on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中划去了错误的答案。
words.en: To decide that something is not possible or not worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然碰见；撞见
words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 追赶；追求；追捕
words.ex: The dog runs after the ball every time.
words.ex_cn: 每次狗都追球跑。
words.en: To chase or pursue someone or something, often in a literal sense of running behind them to catch up.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑；出走；逃避
words.ex: The boy ran away from home.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩从家里跑走了。
words.en: To leave a place or person secretly and suddenly in order to escape from them or to avoid a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: phrase. 竞选；赶快去请
words.ex: He will run for mayor next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将竞选市长。
words.en: To compete for a position or office in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；从…跑出
words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人送行
words.ex: I will see my brother off at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我会去机场为我哥哥送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, especially as a gesture of farewell.

words.tr: phrase. 派人去叫；派人去请；派人去取
words.ex: He will send for a doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会请医生过来。
words.en: To ask or order that someone or something be brought to you, especially by sending a message.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；到来；嵌入
words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；着手
words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 树立榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets an example by arriving early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早到，树立了榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that other people should copy.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.tr: phrase. 放火烧；点着了…
words.ex: He set fire to the paper in the trash can.
words.ex_cn: 他在垃圾桶里点燃了那张纸。
words.en: To cause something to start burning.

words.tr: phrase. 踏上；进入（某地），尤指首次到达或涉足
words.ex: He will set foot on the moon next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将踏上月球。
words.en: To step onto or enter a place, especially for the first time.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；踏入（某地）
words.ex: He has never set foot in that building.
words.ex_cn: 他从未踏入过那栋大楼。
words.en: To enter or go into a place.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀；卖弄
words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.tr: phrase. 露面；到场；显现
words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭；住口；关严；监禁；封藏
words.ex: Shut up, please, I'm trying to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 闭嘴，求你了，我在睡觉。
words.en: If you tell someone to shut up, you are rudely telling them to stop talking.

words.tr: phrase. 并排；并肩；一起
words.ex: The two boys sat side by side on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩并排坐在长凳上。
words.en: If two or more things are side by side, they are next to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 以便；为了
words.ex: He woke up early so as to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早起床，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of; in order to

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止
words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 只要
words.ex: You can go out so long as you finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 只要你做完作业，就可以出去。
words.en: provided that; on condition that

words.tr: phrase. 加速
words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.tr: phrase. 分手；分裂；解散；分摊
words.ex: They split up after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们在争吵后分开了。
words.en: To end a relationship or partnership; to divide or separate into parts.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: phrase. 盯着看；凝视
words.ex: He stares at the clock every minute.
words.ex_cn: 他每分钟都盯着时钟看。
words.en: To look at someone or something for a long time with the eyes wide open, especially when surprised, angry, or because you are thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；回避；不接近
words.ex: Please stay away from the wet floor.
words.ex_cn: 请远离湿漉漉的地板。
words.en: To keep at a distance from someone or something; to avoid being near someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 与...保持联系
words.ex: I stay in touch with my old friends by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和老朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜；不睡觉
words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；突出；坚持到底；显眼
words.ex: The boy stuck out his tongue at the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩对老师吐了吐舌头。
words.en: If something sticks out, it extends beyond something else. If you stick out part of your body, you extend it away from your body.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 成功做成某事；在做某事上取得成功
words.ex: He will succeed in doing something if he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力，他就会成功做成某事。
words.en: To achieve a desired outcome or complete a task successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 例如；像…这样的
words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受；患病
words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 合计；总计；概括
words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: phrase. 接通；开启
words.ex: He switches on the light when it gets dark.
words.ex_cn: 天黑时，他打开灯。
words.en: To turn on an electrical device by operating a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 深呼吸；喘口气
words.ex: He took a breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸了一口气。
words.en: To pause and inhale and exhale air, especially as a way to calm down or prepare for something.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险
words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险；碰运气
words.ex: He takes chances to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险去赢得比赛。
words.en: To take risks or to do something that involves a risk of failure or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 请一天假；休息一天
words.ex: He will take a day off tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要休息一天。
words.en: To take a day off means to decide not to go to work or school on a particular day, usually for rest or personal reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 看一看；查看；审视
words.ex: Take a look at this picture.
words.ex_cn: 看一下这张图片。
words.en: To examine or inspect something briefly.

words.tr: phrase. 散步
words.ex: He takes a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；欺骗；占便宜
words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 与 ... 相像；效仿
words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.tr: phrase. 瞄准；针对；把…作为目标
words.ex: He takes aim at the target with a bow and arrow.
words.ex_cn: 他用弓箭瞄准目标。
words.en: To direct one's effort or attention towards a particular target or goal.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感兴趣
words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸； 拆开
words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: phrase. 拿走；取走；扣除
words.ex: He takes away the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具拿走。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract a number or amount from another.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 使……措手不及；出其不意地袭击或惊吓
words.ex: The test results took her by surprise.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果让她大吃一惊。
words.en: To cause someone to feel surprised because they were not expecting something.

words.tr: phrase. 当心
words.ex: Take care when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious or attentive; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；看管
words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.tr: phrase. 掌握；控制；指挥（尤指军队或组织）
words.ex: He takes command of the team during the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中指挥这支队伍。
words.en: To assume control or authority over a group, organization, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；掌管
words.ex: He decided to take control of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他决定掌控自己的生活。
words.en: To take control of something means to gain the power or authority to manage or direct it.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.tr: phrase. 生效；开始起作用
words.ex: The new rule will take effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将在下周一生效。
words.en: If something takes effect, it begins to produce results or to work.

words.tr: phrase. 进行锻炼；做运动
words.ex: He takes exercise every morning in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园里锻炼。
words.en: To perform physical activities in order to stay healthy and improve physical fitness.

words.tr: 短语. 以……为例；拿……来说
words.ex: Many animals are smart; take dogs for example.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物都很聪明；以狗为例。
words.en: To mention someone or something as an illustration or instance of what is being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…理所当然；想当然
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal without thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 握住；控制住；掌握
words.ex: He takes hold of the rope to climb up.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住绳子往上爬。
words.en: To grasp or seize something with the hands; to gain control or influence over something.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 把…列入考虑中
words.ex: We must take the weather into account when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: If you take something into account, you consider it when you are thinking about a situation or deciding what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 把…考虑进去
words.ex: We must take the weather into consideration before planning the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在计划旅行之前，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To think about and include something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施；采取行动（以应对某种情况或解决问题）
words.ex: The government will take measures to stop pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府将采取措施来阻止污染。
words.en: To take measures means to do something in order to achieve a particular result or to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 注意；理会；留心
words.ex: He did not take notice of the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意到那个警告标志。
words.en: To become aware of something or someone, especially by seeing or hearing them.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 就职；上任；开始担任公职
words.ex: He took office last January.
words.ex_cn: 他去年一月上任。
words.en: To assume a position of authority or responsibility, especially in a formal or official capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 就座；坐下（指正式或指定的位置）
words.ex: Please take your seat before the movie starts.
words.ex_cn: 电影开始前请就座。
words.en: To sit down in a place that has been prepared or assigned for one, especially in a formal or public setting.

words.tr: phrase. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫地做某事
words.ex: He takes his time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢做作业，不着急。
words.en: To use as much time as one needs, without hurrying.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 接管；接任；取代
words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 下苦功；费心尽力；认真努力做某事
words.ex: He takes pains to help his classmates with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他费尽心思帮助同学做作业。
words.en: If you take pains to do something or go to great pains to do something, you try hard to do it, because you think it is important to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；参与
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 发生
words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: phrase. 占有；拥有；取得…的控制权
words.ex: He takes possession of the house on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期一正式拥有这栋房子。
words.en: To take possession of something means to gain control or ownership of it.

words.tr: phrase. 以 ... 自豪
words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险
words.ex: He takes risks to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险创业。
words.en: To undertake actions or decisions that involve the possibility of loss or failure.

words.tr: phrase. 拥抱某人；把某人搂在怀里
words.ex: She took the child in her arms and hugged him tightly.
words.ex_cn: 她把孩子抱在怀里，紧紧地搂着他。
words.en: To embrace someone with one's arms, typically as a gesture of affection or comfort.

words.tr: phrase. 接受某人的建议；听从某人的劝告
words.ex: He took his teacher's advice and studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了老师的建议，更加努力学习。
words.en: To accept or follow the suggestions or recommendations given by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 代替某人；取代某人的位置
words.ex: He will take his brother's place in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替他哥哥参加比赛。
words.en: To take someone's place means to do something that another person was going to do, because they are unable to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；站在……一边；偏袒
words.ex: He always takes sides with his brother in arguments.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中总是站在他兄弟一边。
words.en: To support or agree with a particular person or group in an argument or dispute.

words.tr: phrase. 为首；带头
words.ex: Tom takes the lead in the race.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆在比赛中领先。
words.en: To be in the leading position in a competition, race, or any activity.

words.tr: phrase. 代替
words.ex: Computers can take the place of typewriters.
words.ex_cn: 计算机可以取代打字机。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone means to replace them or to be used instead of them.

words.tr: phrase. 轮流；更替
words.ex: The children take turns to play with the toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们轮流玩这个玩具。
words.en: If people take turns doing something, they do it one after the other to ensure that each person has an equal opportunity to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 谈论；说到；提及
words.ex: Everyone is talking of the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 大家都在谈论这部电影。
words.en: To speak about someone or something; to mention someone or something in conversation.

words.tr: phrase. 谈论；议论；讨论
words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 与...谈话
words.ex: I talk to my friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天和我的朋友聊天。
words.en: To speak to someone in order to give information, express thoughts or feelings, or discuss something.

words.tr: phrase. 自学；自己教自己
words.ex: He teaches himself English with a book.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书自学英语。
words.en: To learn something by oneself without the help of a teacher.

words.tr: phrase. 扯下；拆卸
words.ex: He tore down the poster from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报从墙上扯了下来。
words.en: To tear down something means to destroy or remove it completely, especially a building or other structure.

words.tr: phrase. 撕下；匆匆完成；跑掉
words.ex: He tore off the label from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子上的标签撕掉了。
words.en: To remove something by pulling it roughly or violently.

words.tr: phrase. 撕碎；撕毁；使情绪激动（尤指哭泣）
words.ex: He tore up the letter in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把信撕碎了。
words.en: To destroy something, especially paper or cloth, by pulling it into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 讲笑话；说个笑话
words.ex: He tells a joke to make his friends laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一个笑话来让朋友们笑。
words.en: Share a humorous story or remark to amuse others.

words.tr: phrase. 讲笑话；说笑话
words.ex: He likes to tell jokes at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在聚会上讲笑话。
words.en: To tell jokes means to say things that are intended to make people laugh, often in a social setting.

words.tr: phrase. 说谎
words.ex: He tells a lie to avoid trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他撒谎以避免麻烦。
words.en: To say something that is not true in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: phrase. 说谎；撒谎
words.ex: He tells lies to avoid getting in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他撒谎是为了避免惹上麻烦。
words.en: To tell lies means to say something that is not true, especially with the intention to deceive.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；分辨（常用于指区分两个或多个相似的人或物）
words.ex: I can't tell the twins apart.
words.ex_cn: 我分不清这对双胞胎。
words.en: To recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 通过…判断；根据…辨别
words.ex: You can tell by the way he walks that he's tired.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从他走路的方式判断出他累了。
words.en: To deduce or infer something from a particular sign or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 告诉某人某事；向某人讲述某事
words.ex: He told me about the new project.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉我关于这个新项目。
words.en: To inform someone about something.

words.tr: phrase. 说实话；讲真话
words.ex: He can tell the truth to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他可以对他的老师说实话。
words.en: To speak honestly; to not lie or deceive.

words.tr: phrase. 测试；试验；检验（某物是否有效或适用）
words.ex: He will test out the new machine tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要测试这台新机器。
words.en: To try something to see if it works or is suitable.

words.tr: phrase. 幸亏；由于；因为
words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 就是说；换句话说
words.ex: He is late, that is to say, he will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，也就是说，他会错过公交车。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that makes the meaning of something clearer or gives more information

words.tr: phrase. 后天
words.ex: I will go to the park the day after tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我后天去公园。
words.en: The day after tomorrow refers to the day following tomorrow, which is two days from now.

words.tr: phrase. 前几天；不久前的一天
words.ex: I saw him the other day at the park.
words.ex_cn: 前几天我在公园里看到他了。
words.en: A few days ago.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑；认为
words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.tr: phrase. 出声思考；把想法说出来
words.ex: He thinks aloud while solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解数学题时出声思考。
words.en: To speak one's thoughts audibly, especially as a way of working through a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 回忆起；回想（某事或某时）
words.ex: I often think back to my childhood with great fondness.
words.ex_cn: 我经常怀着极大的喜爱回忆起我的童年。
words.en: To remember or recall something from the past.

words.tr: phrase. 看重；器重
words.ex: They think highly of their teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们非常尊敬他们的老师。
words.en: To have a very good opinion of someone or something; to regard someone or something with great respect or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有好感；高度评价；认为…很好
words.ex: They think well of their teacher because she is kind and helpful.
words.ex_cn: 他们很尊敬他们的老师，因为她很友善且乐于助人。
words.en: To have a good opinion of someone or something; to respect or admire.

words.tr: phrase. 认为……没什么大不了；对……不以为意
words.ex: He thinks nothing of walking two miles to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得每天步行两英里去学校没什么大不了的。
words.en: To consider something to be easy or not important.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 把……看作……；认为……是……
words.ex: We think of water as a basic need.
words.ex_cn: 我们认为水是一种基本需求。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；想出（解决方案或计划）
words.ex: He thinks out the answer carefully before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前仔细思考答案。
words.en: To think something out means to consider it carefully and thoroughly before making a decision or taking action.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 想出；构思出（主意、计划等）
words.ex: He can think up new ideas very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快想出新点子。
words.en: To invent or devise something.

words.tr: phrase. 数千的
words.ex: Thousands of people attended the concert.
words.ex_cn: 数千人参加了这场音乐会。
words.en: A large number of something, typically more than a thousand.

words.tr: phrase. 扔掉；丢弃
words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；使…清楚明白；提供线索或解释
words.ex: The new evidence throws light on the mystery.
words.ex_cn: 新证据揭示了这个谜团的真相。
words.en: To provide information or explanation that makes something easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 扔开；去掉；摆脱
words.ex: He threw off his coat and started working.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下外套，开始工作。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is bothering you or that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己依赖于；投身于；乞求（某人）的怜悯或帮助
words.ex: He threw himself on the ground to avoid the falling glass.
words.ex_cn: 他扑到地上以避开掉落的玻璃。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for help or support, often in a desperate or urgent situation.

words.tr: phrase. 呕吐；恶心；匆匆建造；产生；放弃
words.ex: He eats too fast and sometimes throws up.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得很快，有时会呕吐。
words.en: To vomit; to eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后会收拾房间。
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；屡次；反复地
words.ex: He makes the same mistake time and again.
words.ex_cn: 他一次又一次地犯同样的错误。
words.en: If something happens time and again, it happens repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 直到现在；迄今
words.ex: Till now, we have completed half of the project.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，我们已经完成了项目的一半。
words.en: Until now; up to the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 使极度劳累
words.ex: The long walk makes me tire out.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的步行让我筋疲力尽。
words.en: To make someone extremely tired.

words.tr: phrase. 老实说；说实在的
words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.tr: phrase. 值得赞扬的是；为…增光（用于肯定某人的优点或成就）
words.ex: To his credit, he helped the stranger without asking for anything.
words.ex_cn: 值得赞扬的是，他帮助了那个陌生人，却没有要求任何回报。
words.en: If you say that something is to someone's credit, you mean that they should be praised for it, although it may seem surprising given their other actions.

words.tr: 短语. 令某人高兴的是
words.ex: To his delight, the dog returned home.
words.ex_cn: 令他高兴的是，狗回家了。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens that makes someone very happy.

words.tr: 短语. 令某人惊讶的是
words.ex: To his surprise, the dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 令他惊讶的是，狗跳过了篱笆。
words.en: used to indicate that something happened in a way that was unexpected to someone

words.tr: phrase. 相反
words.ex: He said it was easy, but to the contrary, it was very hard.
words.ex_cn: 他说这很容易，但恰恰相反，它非常难。
words.en: If you say 'to the contrary', you are indicating that the opposite of what has been said is true.

words.tr: phrase. 切题；切中要害；中肯；扼要
words.ex: His answer was to the point.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答切中要点。
words.en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as to the point, you approve of it because it is relevant to the subject and does not contain anything unnecessary.

words.tr: phrase. 连同；一起
words.ex: He plays soccer together with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: In addition to someone or something else; alongside.

words.tr: phrase. 过多；太多
words.ex: He ate too much candy and felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多糖果，感觉不舒服。
words.en: An excessive amount; more than is necessary or desirable.

words.tr: phrase. 太……而不能……（用于表达程度过高导致无法做某事）
words.ex: He is too tired to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，走不动了。
words.en: Used to say that something is not possible because a quality or condition is too extreme.

words.tr: phrase. 与…进行贸易；与…做生意
words.ex: They trade with their neighbors for food and tools.
words.ex_cn: 他们与邻居交换食物和工具。
words.en: To engage in the buying and selling of goods and services with someone or some entity.

words.tr: v. 转化；翻译；
words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看作…
words.ex: We should treat everyone as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该把每个人都当作朋友。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 请客；招待（某人）享用（某物）
words.ex: He treats his friends to ice cream every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都请朋友们吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you treat someone to something special that they will enjoy, you buy it or arrange it for them.

words.tr: phrase. 欺骗某人做某事
words.ex: He tricked his brother into cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他骗他弟弟打扫他的房间。
words.en: To deceive someone into doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 被…绊倒；因…而跌倒
words.ex: He tripped over a rock and fell.
words.ex_cn: 他被一块石头绊倒了。
words.en: To catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall.

words.tr: v. 尝试；试图；努力；
words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；试图做某事
words.ex: I try to do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都试着做作业。
words.en: to make an attempt or effort to do something

words.tr: phrase. 对...熟视无睹
words.ex: He saw the mistake but decided to turn a blind eye to it.
words.ex_cn: 他看到了那个错误，但决定视而不见。
words.en: If you say that someone is turning a blind eye to something bad or illegal that is happening, you mean that you think they are pretending not to notice that it is happening so that they will not have to do anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. 背叛；使对抗
words.ex: He turned against his friend because of a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一次大争吵而背弃了他的朋友。
words.en: To change from being friendly or supportive to being hostile or opposed to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 转身；（使）好转；（使）扭转局面
words.ex: He heard a noise and told me to turn around.
words.ex_cn: 他听到一声响动，叫我转过身来。
words.en: To change direction so as to face the opposite way; to change something bad into something good.

words.tr: phrase. 转身离开；拒绝进入；把脸转开
words.ex: The guard will turn away anyone without a ticket.
words.ex_cn: 没有票的人，警卫都会拒之门外。
words.en: If you turn someone away, you do not allow them to enter a place or join an organization, often because there is no room for them or because they are not suitable.

words.tr: phrase. 使停止往前；往回走
words.ex: He turned back when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他往回走了。
words.en: To go back in the direction you have come from, or to make someone or something do this.

words.tr: phrase. 调低；关小；拒绝
words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.tr: phrase. （使）变成；成为
words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.tr: phrase. 背弃；拒绝帮助；不理睬
words.ex: He turned his back on his friend when he needed help.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友需要帮助时，他却背弃了他。
words.en: To refuse to help or support someone or something; to abandon or reject.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 翻转；移交；换台；营业额达到；反复考虑
words.ex: He turned over the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子把煎饼翻了个面。
words.en: To cause something to move so that a different side is facing upwards; to transfer or hand over something to someone else; to achieve a certain amount of business.

words.tr: phrase. 回到；返回到
words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.tr: adj. 未成年的；未到法定年龄的
words.ex: He is underage to buy alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他还未成年，不能买酒。
words.en: Underage refers to someone who is below the legal age for a particular activity, especially drinking alcohol or voting.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下；无论如何
words.ex: You must not lie under any circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 在任何情况下你都不能撒谎。
words.en: In any possible situation; no matter what happens.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下；无论如何
words.ex: He will tell the truth under all circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 在任何情况下，他都会说真话。
words.en: In every possible situation; no matter what happens.

words.tr: 短语. 正在建设中；施工中
words.ex: The bridge is under construction.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥正在建设中。
words.en: If a building or other structure is under construction, it is being built.

words.tr: phrase. 被控制住
words.ex: The fire is under control.
words.ex_cn: 火势得到了控制。
words.en: If a situation or a person is under control, they are being dealt with successfully and there is no danger of them becoming unmanageable.

words.tr: phrase. 在压力之下
words.ex: He works well under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下工作得很好。
words.en: Being subjected to stress or coercion.

words.tr: 短语. 正在修理中；维修中
words.ex: The bathroom is under repair.
words.ex_cn: 洗手间正在维修。
words.en: If something is under repair, it is being fixed or is in the process of being fixed.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的指导下；受某人指挥
words.ex: The workers built the house under the manager's direction.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在经理的指导下建了房子。
words.en: Being guided or managed by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的管理/负责之下
words.ex: The child is under the charge of his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子由他的祖母照看。
words.en: Being managed or supervised by someone or an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 以…的名义
words.ex: He works under the name of John Smith.
words.ex_cn: 他以约翰·史密斯的名字工作。
words.en: Using the name of someone or something else as an identity or title.

words.tr: phrase. 在进行中
words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

words.tr: phrase. 上上下下；前前后后
words.ex: The ball goes up and down when he throws it.
words.ex_cn: 当他扔球时，球上下弹跳。
words.en: Moving alternately upwards and downwards or back and forth.

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决的；未确定的；不确定的
words.ex: The plans are up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 计划还未确定。
words.en: If a matter is up in the air, it is uncertain, often because other matters have to be decided first.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: phrase. 最近的；最新的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up to date.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己的知识保持最新。
words.en: If something is up to date, it is the newest thing of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 直到现在；迄今为止
words.ex: Up to now, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Until the present moment.

words.tr: phrase. 直到（某一时间或事件）
words.ex: He worked there up until last month.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在那里工作到上个月。
words.en: Up until is used to indicate that something continues to happen or be true up to a particular point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 颠倒；乱七八糟
words.ex: The picture is upside down.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片是倒着的。
words.en: If something is upside down, it is in a position in which the part that is usually at the bottom is at the top.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽
words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.tr: 短语. 过去常常做某事（表示过去习惯性或经常性的动作，现在已不再如此）
words.ex: I used to play football every day when I was young.
words.ex_cn: 我小时候每天都踢足球。
words.en: If you used to do something, you did it regularly in the past, but you no longer do it.

words.tr: phrase. 从……到……变化；在……范围内变动
words.ex: The weather can vary from cold to hot in one day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可能在一天之内从寒冷变为炎热。
words.en: To differ in size, amount, degree, or nature from one thing or situation to another.

words.tr: phrase. 把...看做；把...视为
words.ex: Many people view the ocean as a source of life.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为海洋是生命的源泉。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 投票反对；表决反对
words.ex: They vote against the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他们投票反对新规则。
words.en: To express one's opposition to a proposal or candidate by voting.

words.tr: phrase. 投票支持；选举（某人）
words.ex: I will vote for her in the election.
words.ex_cn: 我将在选举中投她一票。
words.en: To express one's choice or preference in a decision-making process, especially in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 等待
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；招待；焦急地等待
words.ex: The waitress waits on customers at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员在晚餐时服侍顾客。
words.en: To serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant or at a table; to wait for something to happen or for someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；伺候；拜访（某人）
words.ex: He had to wait upon the king during the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上不得不侍候国王。
words.en: To serve or attend to someone, especially in a formal or ceremonial capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 醒来；叫醒
words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.
